name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
flavorText: A silver bowl, always beaded with cold water no matter how dry the room.
description: Fill the bowl with water and speak the command word to summon and command a water elemental as if you had cast Conjure Elemental — no concentration required. It serves for 1 hour or until dismissed. Usable once per day.

name: Instant Fortress
flavorText: A small, dense model of a fortress tower, heavier than its size should allow.
description: Thrown to the ground and given its command word, this item unfolds within 1 minute into a full stone tower — 20-foot square base, 30 feet tall, arrow slits, a heavy door — sturdy enough to house a small company. Speaking the command word again folds it back down, ejecting (unharmed) anyone inside first.

name: Sovereign Glue
flavorText: A small, heavy clay jar, sealed with wax and warded against ever drying out on its own.
description: This jar holds 4 ounces of an adhesive that bonds two objects permanently within 1 minute of application, and can only be dissolved by Universal Solvent or a Wish. A single jar has enough for one use.

name: Ring of Protection
flavorText: A plain, unassuming ring that hums faintly with a steady, watchful ward.
description: +1 bonus to AC and all saving throws. Requires attunement.

name: Ring of the Ram
flavorText: A heavy signet ring stamped with the curling horns of a ram.
description: 3 charges. As an action, expend 1-3 charges to make a ranged spell attack (+7 to damage rolls) against a target within 60 ft.: 2d10 force damage per charge spent, and a Large or smaller target is pushed 5 ft. away per charge spent. Recharges 1d6+1 charges each dawn. Requires attunement.

name: Warded Vault-Chest
flavorText: A steel-cornered chest etched with a ward-glyph that hums faintly when approached — armed, but not against you, not right now.
description: Open to find a haul of superrare-tier loot and coin.

name: Vorpal Sword
flavorText: A gleaming longsword of terrifying sharpness.
description: +3 to damage rolls. Natural 20: severs target's head (instantly killing most creatures). No effect on creatures that don't need heads. Ignores slashing resistance. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Sever the head of 3 different creatures using the vorpal effect.
unlocks.reward: The vorpal effect now also triggers on a natural 19, and any creature slain this way cannot be raised as undead by means short of a Wish.

name: Staff of Power
flavorText: A white-gold staff crackling with arcane energy.
description: 20 charges. +2 to damage rolls, damage rolls, AC, saving throws, and spell attack rolls while holding. Spells: Cone of Cold (5), Fireball 5th-level (5), Globe of Invulnerability (6), Hold Monster (5), Levitate (2), Lightning Bolt 5th-level (5), Magic Missile (1), Ray of Enfeeblement (1), Wall of Force (5). Retributive Strike: shatter the staff — 16d6 force damage in 30-ft radius (DC 17 Dex for half), and you take half of remaining charges as d6 force damage. Recharges 1d8+4 charges each day. Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard.

name: Ring of Three Wishes
flavorText: A plain gold ring bearing faint script. One wish remains.
description: 1 charge remaining. Expend to cast Wish. Ring becomes mundane after last charge. Stress effects possible: aging, disadvantage on attacks/saves for 2d4 days. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the ring's final wish and survive whatever stress effect it caused.
unlocks.reward: Rather than immediately going mundane, the ring retains one last flicker of magic: it can be used once more to cast Contact Other Plane or Legend Lore for free before finally losing its power.

name: Cloak of Invisibility
flavorText: A shimmering grey cloak. While hood is up, the wearer is completely invisible.
description: Hood up while worn: Invisible. Up to 2 hours per day (in 1-minute increments). While not invisible, cloak is translucent. Requires attunement.

name: Robe of the Archmagi
flavorText: A white silk robe trimmed in gold.
description: AC 7 + Dex modifier. +5 spell save DC. Advantage on saves against spells. Requires attunement (sorcerer, warlock, wizard).

name: Sphere of Annihilation
flavorText: A 2-foot sphere of absolute void. Everything it touches is unmade.
description: Hovering sphere of destruction. Creatures/objects touching it: reduced to nothing (no save for ≤100 HP; others DC 13 Con save). Controlled by DC 25 Arcana each round or it moves toward you. Talisman of the Sphere grants advantage.

unlocks.condition: Successfully control the sphere for 10 full rounds without ever losing control of it.
unlocks.reward: The Arcana DC to control the sphere decreases to 20, and if control is ever lost, it now drifts toward the last direction you intended rather than moving randomly.

name: Talisman of Pure Good
flavorText: A golden sunburst pendant.
description: 7 charges. Expend 1: fiend or undead within 30 ft. makes DC 20 Dex save or falls into a radiant chasm, destroying it. Good-aligned cleric/paladin only. Loses magic if held by evil creature. Requires attunement.

name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
flavorText: A black iron disc.
description: 6 charges. Expend 1: celestial within 30 ft. makes DC 20 Dex save or falls into an abyssal chasm, destroying it. Evil-aligned cleric only. Loses magic if held by good creature. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Destroy 3 celestials using the talisman's power.
unlocks.reward: The save DC increases to 22, and destroying a celestial with a Challenge Rating below 5 no longer expends a charge.

name: Tome of Understanding
flavorText: A silver-bound volume.
description: Read over 48 hours across 6 days: Wisdom score and maximum Wisdom permanently +2. Loses magic after use. Recharges magic in a century.

abilities.name: Read
abilities.description: Read over 48 hours across 6 days: Wisdom score and maximum Wisdom permanently +2. Loses magic after use. Recharges magic in a century.

unlocks.condition: Fully absorb the tome's wisdom over its complete reading period.
unlocks.reward: The residual insight lingers permanently: gain expertise (double proficiency) in one Wisdom skill of your choice, unaffected by the tome later losing its magic.

name: Apparatus of Kwalish
flavorText: A sealed iron crab-shaped vessel — a one-person submersible.
description: 10-ft long, 500 lbs. Holds 2. Walk and swim speed 30 ft. AC 20, 200 HP. Claws: 1d10+4 bludgeoning. Lever-operated. Sealed to any water pressure depth.

unlocks.condition: Use the apparatus to survive an environment that would otherwise be lethal — deep water, toxic gas, or crushing pressure.
unlocks.reward: Its claws' damage increases to 2d10+4, and its walking and swimming speed increases to 40 ft.

name: Plate Armor of Invulnerability
flavorText: Full plate armor. Once per day: immune to all non-magical damage.
description: AC 9. Resistance to non-magical damage at all times. Action once per day: immunity to non-magical damage for 10 minutes. Requires attunement.

name: Cloak of Arachnida
flavorText: A dark purple cloak.
description: Resistance to poison damage. Immune to Poisoned condition. Spider Climb (walls/ceilings). Immune to webs (magical and mundane). Cast Web (DC 13) once per day. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the cloak's Web spell to trap 5 different creatures.
unlocks.reward: Web can now be cast twice per day, and you gain advantage on saves against being restrained in addition to the cloak's other effects.

name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
flavorText: A flawless crystal orb for scrying and telepathic communication.
description: Scry on any creature (DC 17 Wisdom save to resist). While scrying: cast Detect Thoughts (DC 13) or communicate telepathically with target. Once per day, up to 1 hour. Requires attunement.

name: Defender Longsword
flavorText: A longsword of elegant power.
description: +3 to damage rolls. Each turn before attacking: transfer any or all of the +3 bonus to your AC instead. Bonus resets each turn. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Successfully transfer the full +3 bonus to AC and survive a hit you'd have otherwise taken, 10 times.
unlocks.reward: The transferable bonus increases to +4, and any portion allocated to AC persists for 1 extra round if you choose not to attack that turn.

name: Eye of Vecna
flavorText: A preserved humanoid eye that must replace the user's own.
description: Remove your eye and press it in (1d6 necrotic damage). Gain: infinite Darkvision, Truesight 120 ft., X-Ray Vision (up to 4-ft solid). Once per day: Disintegrate (DC 18) or Dominate Monster (DC 18). Cannot be voluntarily removed.

unlocks.condition: Use the Eye's Disintegrate or Dominate Monster to defeat 3 separate creatures of CR 10 or higher.
unlocks.reward: Both abilities become available twice per day instead of once.

name: Hand of Vecna
flavorText: A severed mummified hand that must replace the user's own.
description: Sever your hand (1 HP remaining). Attach the Hand (1 hour, 10 HP). Gain: +2 Strength, cold immunity, Clairvoyance 3/day, Finger of Death 1/day (DC 18), Telekinesis 2/day. Cannot be voluntarily removed once attached.

name: Helm of Brilliance
flavorText: A helm studded with gems of varying types.
description: Contains 10 diamonds, 20 rubies, 30 fire opals, 40 opals. Each gem expends for a spell: diamond=Prismatic Spray (DC 18), ruby=Wall of Fire, fire opal=Fireball (DC 18), opal=Daylight. Undead within 30 ft. take 1d6 radiant/turn. On fire damage taken: DC 13 Dex or random gem explodes. Last gem removed: 6d6 radiant 30-ft radius, helm becomes mundane. Requires attunement.

name: Holy Avenger
flavorText: A longsword inscribed with divine script.
description: +3 to damage rolls. +2d10 radiant against undead and fiends. 10-ft aura: creatures in aura have advantage on saves against spells and effects of fiends/undead. Requires attunement by a paladin.

unlocks.condition: Destroy 5 fiends or undead with this blade while an ally benefits from its protective aura.
unlocks.reward: Radiant bonus damage against undead and fiends increases to 3d10, and the protective aura's radius increases to 20 ft.

name: Ioun Stone of Absorption
flavorText: A pale lavender ellipsoid orbiting the wearer's head.
description: Absorbs spells of 4th level or lower targeting you, destroying them harmlessly. Total absorption capacity: 50 levels before becoming nonmagical. Track cumulative absorption. Requires attunement.

name: Iron Flask
flavorText: A stoppered iron bottle sealed with a brass rune.
description: Contains a powerful creature (GM assigns — often a demon lord, devil, elemental, or unique entity). Speak the rune while uncorking: DC 17 Charisma (Persuasion) or creature ignores you. On success: obeys for 1 hour. Can hold only one creature at a time.

unlocks.condition: Bind a creature and later release it on terms that don't end in it immediately attacking you.
unlocks.reward: The Persuasion DC to compel a bound creature's service decreases to 15, and a bound creature cannot escape the flask even via plane-shifting magic.

name: Luck Blade
flavorText: A shortsword of supernal fortune containing a Wish.
description: +3 to damage rolls. +1 to all saving throws. Once per day: reroll one attack, save, or ability check (before knowing result). Contains 1 Wish remaining. Requires attunement.

name: Moonblade
flavorText: An elven longsword that bonds to a single bearer and grows in power.
description: +1 to damage rolls (minimum). Each new bearer adds a rune on attunement (roll on DMG p.217 Moonblade table). Max 5 runes. If bearer dies, blade seeks a worthy elf. Requires attunement (elf or half-elf).

unlocks.condition: Be the bearer when the blade gains its 5th and final rune.
unlocks.reward: The blade's minimum bonus increases to +2 attack and damage, and on your death it seeks out a specific worthy elf or half-elf you've personally met, rather than choosing at random.

name: Nine Lives Stealer
flavorText: A longsword that drains the life force of mortals.
description: +2 to damage rolls. Critical hit against creature <100 HP: DC 15 Con save or die instantly. Works up to 9 times before exhausted — track uses. Requires attunement.

name: Oathbow
flavorText: A white longbow that binds to a sworn enemy.
description: Whisper enemy's name: they become your Sworn Enemy. Attacks against them: advantage, +3d6 piercing damage. Against all others while you have a Sworn Enemy: disadvantage. New oath after long rest once previous enemy is dead. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Complete 5 separate oaths by defeating or driving off 5 different Sworn Enemies.
unlocks.reward: Bonus damage against your Sworn Enemy increases to 4d6, and the disadvantage against other targets no longer applies to the first attack of each combat.

name: Potion of Storm Giant Strength
flavorText: A crackling electrified blue-white liquid.
description: Strength set to 29 (Storm Giant) for 1 hour. No effect if Strength already 29+.

name: Ring of Elemental Command
flavorText: A ring attuned to one of the four elemental planes.
description: Roll or GM assigns element. Grants: resistance to that element, Primordial speech, Dominate Elemental (DC 18) 1/day, elemental control spells (see DMG p.189). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use Dominate Elemental to defeat a powerful elemental threat.
unlocks.reward: Dominate Elemental becomes available twice per day, and once per long rest your resistance to the ring's element becomes immunity for 1 minute.

name: Rod of Absorption
flavorText: A silver rod that absorbs spells targeted at the wearer.
description: Reaction: absorb a spell targeting only you. Regain spell slots equal to absorbed spell's level. Max 50 levels total before rod is inert. Track cumulative absorption. Requires attunement.

name: Rod of Alertness
flavorText: A mace-shaped rod granting keen awareness.
description: Advantage on Perception. Cannot be surprised while holding. Detect Evil/Good, Detect Magic, Detect Poison/Disease at will. Once per day: 60-ft protective aura (allies can't be surprised, have advantage on saves vs. Frightened). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the protective aura to prevent an ally from being surprised or ambushed, 5 times.
unlocks.reward: The aura's radius increases to 90 ft., and you and allies within it gain advantage on initiative rolls while it's active.

name: Rod of Security
flavorText: A platinum rod.
description: Once per 10 days: transport up to 200 willing creatures to an extradimensional paradise. Each can remain up to 200 days. No time passes outside. Creatures can choose to leave.

unlocks.condition: Shelter at least 10 creatures inside the rod's paradise during a lethal event (a dragon's attack, a collapsing building, a flood) and bring them all out alive.
unlocks.reward: The paradise becomes reachable every 5 days instead of every 10, and it can now hold up to 300 creatures.

name: Scarab of Protection
flavorText: A scarab beetle charm.
description: 12 charges. Advantage on saves against spells. Expend 1 charge: negate a spell targeting only you. Expend 1 charge: negate a disintegrate or power word effect. At 0 charges, crumbles to dust. Requires attunement.

name: Sword of Answering
flavorText: One of nine swords keyed to the alignment of its god.
description: +3 to damage rolls. Counter: when creature within 5 ft. damages you, use reaction to make one melee attack against it. Advantage on this attack, don't add ability modifier to damage if positive. Requires attunement by a creature of the matching alignment.

name: Talisman of the Sphere
flavorText: A jet black disc.
description: Intelligence (Arcana) checks to control a Sphere of Annihilation have advantage. Sphere moves 20 ft./round toward a designated target. On failed control check, sphere moves randomly. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Successfully control a Sphere of Annihilation using this talisman's advantage, 10 times.
unlocks.reward: The sphere's controlled movement speed doubles to 40 ft. per round, and a failed control check now sends it toward the nearest creature rather than a fully random direction.

name: Wand of Orcus
flavorText: The death wand of the Demon Prince of Undead. It smells of rot and whispers names of the newly dead.
description: 7 charges. +3 to damage rolls. Spells: Animate Dead (1 charge, animates dead within 10 ft.; up to 500 HP total of undead obey you), Circle of Death (3, DC 18, 8d6 necrotic in 60-ft sphere), Finger of Death (3, DC 18, 7d8+30 necrotic; humanoid killed rises as zombie), Power Word Kill (5, kills creature with 100 HP or fewer instantly). Charges do not replenish — once spent, that power is gone. Orcus is aware of whoever carries this wand. Requires attunement.

name: Wave (Trident Artifact)
flavorText: A trident of the sea cresting with ocean-hued gems.
description: Deals 1d6+3 piercing. Thrown (20/60). Trident of Fish Command at will. +2d6 damage against creatures with Amphibious or Swim Speed. Dominate Monster (aquatic, DC 20) 1/day. Water Walk and Water Breathing at will. Demands devotion to a sea deity. Requires attunement.

name: Whelm (Warhammer Artifact)
flavorText: A dwarven warhammer of legendary lineage.
description: +3 to damage rolls. Thrown (20/60): returns to hand. On hit: DC 15 Con save or stunned until end of target's next turn. Fear Aura: giants/trolls within 30 ft. make DC 16 Wisdom save at turn start or Frightened. Detect: sense giant-kin within 240 ft. Requires attunement by a dwarf.

unlocks.condition: Stun 5 different creatures with the hammer's on-hit effect.
unlocks.reward: The stun save DC increases to 17, and the fear aura's radius increases to 45 ft.

name: Blackrazor (Greatsword Artifact)
flavorText: A massive black-bladed sword that devours souls.
description: +3 to damage rolls. Soul Devouring: killing a creature absorbs its soul (creature cannot be resurrected until Blackrazor releases it). Gain 10 temporary HP per devoured soul. Bonus action: Haste for 1 minute. No kills in 3 days: cursed (disadvantage on attacks/saves) until you kill. Requires attunement.

name: Absorbing Tattoo (Greater)
flavorText: A full-arm tattoo of absorbing darkness that drinks in all forms of energy.
description: Requires attunement. Resistance to all damage from spells. Once per day: as a reaction to taking any damage, become immune to that damage type for 1 minute.

unlocks.condition: Trigger the tattoo's reactive immunity 10 times, each time against an attack or effect that would have dealt at least 20 damage.
unlocks.reward: The immunity duration extends to 10 minutes, and it can now be triggered preemptively the instant you see an incoming attack, rather than only after taking the damage.

name: Amulet of the Planes
flavorText: A silver amulet set with a gem that shows a different starscape each morning.
description: Requires attunement. Action: name a location on another plane — DC 15 Intelligence check (DC 21 if on a different plane than your destination). Success: Plane Shift to that location. Failure: roll on the Mishaps table — teleport to a random location on a random plane.

name: Belt of Giant Strength (Frost Giant)
flavorText: A broad leather belt with a white-furred buckle.
description: Requires attunement. Strength score becomes 23 (Frost Giant). No effect if Strength is already 23+.

name: Belt of Giant Strength (Stone Giant)
flavorText: A slate-grey belt with a stone-carved buckle.
description: Requires attunement. Strength score becomes 23 (Stone Giant). No effect if Strength is already 23+.

unlocks.condition: Use your giant strength to accomplish a feat no ordinary creature nearby could match.
unlocks.reward: Your Strength while wearing the belt increases to 25 (as a Fire Giant's), if that would be higher than your current score.

name: Belt of Giant Strength (Fire Giant)
flavorText: A red leather belt with iron studs.
description: Requires attunement. Strength score becomes 25 (Fire Giant). No effect if Strength is already 25+.

name: Candle of Invocation
flavorText: A slender candle in the color of a specific deity's domain.
description: Requires attunement by a cleric or druid of the matching alignment. Burn it: for up to 4 hours (non-consecutive), you and allies within 30 ft. have advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saves, and can cast one spell of 1st level without expending a spell slot. Burns for 4 hours then becomes mundane.

name: Crystal Ball (Standard)
flavorText: A 6-inch perfectly clear crystal sphere.
description: Requires attunement. Once per day: Scry (DC 17) on any creature on the same plane. You see through the orb. Session lasts up to 1 hour. Variants: Telepathy, True Seeing, Mind Reading (each more powerful). Standard version: scrying only.

unlocks.condition: Use Scrying through the ball to gather intelligence that directly changes a mission's outcome, 3 times.
unlocks.reward: Scrying sessions extend to 4 hours, and the DC for the target to notice or resist increases to 19.

name: Helm of Brilliance (Depleted)
flavorText: A helm studded with gem sockets — most now empty, a handful remaining.
description: +1 AC. Contains 3 fire opals and 5 opals remaining. Each gem expends for a spell: fire opal = Fireball (DC 15), opal = Daylight. Undead within 30 ft. take 1d6 radiant per turn. On fire damage taken: DC 13 Dex save or remaining gem explodes. Requires attunement.

name: Manual of Gainful Exercise
flavorText: A heavy leather-bound tome with an iron-embossed cover.
description: Read over 48 hours across 6 days: Strength score and maximum Strength permanently increase by 2. Tome loses magic after use. Recharges magic in a century.

abilities.name: Read
abilities.description: Read over 48 hours across 6 days: Strength score and maximum Strength permanently increase by 2. Tome loses magic after use. Recharges magic in a century.

unlocks.condition: Fully absorb the manual's strength training.
unlocks.reward: The trained edge lingers permanently: gain proficiency in Athletics, unaffected by the tome later going dormant.

name: Potion of Giant Strength (Storm)
flavorText: A crackling blue-white liquid in a stout flask.
description: Strength set to 29 (Storm Giant) for 1 hour. No effect if Strength is already 29+.

name: Robe of Scintillating Colors
flavorText: A pale robe that bursts into swirling prismatic patterns when activated.
description: +2 AC. Requires attunement. While wearing: as a bonus action, activate the colors for 1 minute. While active: attackers must make DC 15 Wisdom save or be Blinded until end of their next turn. Creatures within 25 ft. that can see you are Dazzled (disadvantage on attack rolls against you).

unlocks.condition: Blind 5 different creatures using the robe's activated colors.
unlocks.reward: After the first activation each day, further activations cost no action at all for the rest of that encounter, and the blinded duration extends to 1 minute.

name: Devotee's Censer
flavorText: A silver censer on a chain, inscribed with holy script that shifts as you read it.
description: +2 to damage rolls (flail). Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin. While swinging (using the Attack action): allies within 10 ft. regain 1d6 HP at the start of your next turn. Once per day: cast Dispel Evil and Good without components.

unlocks.condition: Heal a combined 100 HP to allies using the censer's aura.
unlocks.reward: The healing aura increases to 2d6, and the censer's Dispel Magic can be cast twice per day instead of once.

name: Helm of Awareness
flavorText: A smooth steel helm inset with a small mirror on the brow.
description: +1 AC. Requires attunement. Advantage on initiative rolls. Cannot be surprised while conscious. If another creature would gain a surprise attack against you, it instead must make a DC 14 Dexterity save or lose the surprise.

name: Dragonhide Plate Armor
flavorText: Full suit of armor made from treated dragon hide, flexible yet incredibly durable.
description: AC 7 + Dex modifier (max 2). Resistance to the damage type of the dragon whose hide this was. Advantage on saving throws against Frightful Presence and breath weapons of that dragon type. Requires attunement.

name: Dragon Vessel
flavorText: A vessel of dragon bone that radiates warmth.
description: Requires attunement by a dragon or a creature with the Draconic Resistance trait. Once per day: as a bonus action, exhale draconic energy in a 30-ft cone — 8d6 damage of the dragon's type (Dex DC 15 for half). Also: resistance to that damage type while attuned.

unlocks.condition: Use the draconic breath to defeat 3 different creatures, one per blast.
unlocks.reward: The cone extends to 60 ft., and the damage increases to 10d6.

name: Sword +3
flavorText: A longsword of exceptional magical potency.
description: +3 to damage rolls. Versatile (1d10+3). Counts as magical and overcomes any resistance or immunity to non-magical slashing. Requires attunement.

name: Wand of Orcus (Fragment)
flavorText: A broken shard of what was once a greater weapon, radiating necrotic energy.
description: +1 to damage rolls. 3 charges. Expend 1: animate one nearby corpse as a zombie (CR 1/4 or lower) that obeys your commands for 1 hour. Expend 2: Finger of Death (DC 15, 7d8+30 necrotic; humanoid killed rises as zombie). Charges do not replenish. Requires attunement.

name: Orichalcum Plate Helm
flavorText: A full-face orichalcum helm matched to a plate armor set.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Does not require attunement.

name: Orichalcum Plate Gauntlets
flavorText: Articulated orichalcum gauntlets, hinged at the knuckles for a full grip.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Does not require attunement.

name: Orichalcum Plate Greaves
flavorText: Orichalcum greaves covering the thighs and shins, buckled at the sides.
description: +3 bonus to AC. Does not require attunement.

name: Orichalcum Plate Boots
flavorText: Reinforced orichalcum sabatons with articulated toe plates.
description: +2 bonus to AC. Does not require attunement.

name: Orichalcum Plate Shield
flavorText: A kite shield of solid orichalcum, sized to match a full plate ensemble.
description: +4 AC. Exceeds the protection of a standard shield on its own merits. Does not require attunement.

name: Orichalcum Shortsword
flavorText: An orichalcum short, balanced blade suited to quick strikes.
description: Finesse, light. +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Orichalcum Longsword
flavorText: An orichalcum straight double-edged blade about a yard long.
description: Versatile (1d10). +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Orichalcum Dagger
flavorText: An orichalcum short double-edged blade with a simple crossguard.
description: Finesse, light, thrown (range 20/60). +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Orichalcum Mace
flavorText: An orichalcum flanged metal head on a sturdy haft.
description: Bludgeoning. +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Orichalcum Battleaxe
flavorText: An orichalcum broad single-bladed axe head on a long haft.
description: Versatile (1d10). +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Orichalcum Warhammer
flavorText: An orichalcum heavy square hammerhead built for crushing blows.
description: Versatile (1d10). +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Orichalcum Spear
flavorText: An orichalcum long haft tipped with a leaf-shaped point.
description: Thrown (range 20/60), versatile (1d8). +2 to damage rolls. The metal seems to hum faintly when swung in earnest.

name: Baby Griffon
flavorText: A young griffon, still growing into its wings, fiercely loyal to whoever raised it from the egg.
description: Fly speed 60 ft. once fully grown (matures over roughly a year of ownership; grants advantage on Animal Handling checks involving flying beasts until then). Once grown, it fights alongside its owner once per short rest with its own claw attack (2d6+3 slashing).

unlocks.condition: Raise the griffon to full maturity (about a year of ownership), then win 3 separate battles with it fighting alongside you.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, the griffon carries you and one other Medium creature aloft for up to 10 minutes at a fly speed of 60 ft; the first attack you make each turn from its back after it dives at least 20 ft has advantage.

name: Sworn Sprite
flavorText: A tiny fey warrior no taller than a hand, armed with a sword and a longbow sized to match.
description: Can cast Heart Sight once per short rest on its owner's behalf. Advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened while it's within 10 ft. Its longbow (1d4 piercing plus 1d4 poison, DC 13 Con save or poisoned 1 minute) can be loosed once per short rest to assist its owner in combat.

unlocks.condition: Win 3 separate fights in which the sprite's poisoned arrow struck at least one enemy and you used Heart Sight beforehand to learn an enemy's intent.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, the sprite casts Faerie Fire on a 20-ft cube centered on a point within 60 ft; you and your allies have advantage on attack rolls against creatures outlined by it.

name: Pixie Bound by Favor
flavorText: A mischievous, glowing fey no bigger than a sparrow, who owes a debt it intends to repay exactly once.
description: Can cast Polymorph on its owner once, ever, when the debt is called in (GM discretion on timing/target). Until then, it can turn invisible at will and cast Dancing Lights or Disguise Self on its owner's behalf freely, plus Confusion once per day as a personal favor.

unlocks.condition: Learn something true about the nature of the pixie's debt, from the pixie itself or another source with no reason to lie.
unlocks.reward: Confusion can now be cast twice per day instead of once, and Disguise Self/Dancing Lights remain available even during the periods it would normally need to recover.

name: Displacer Beast Cub
flavorText: A young displacer beast, its light-bending fur not yet fully reliable, tentacles still a bit clumsy.
description: Once per short rest, grant its owner the Displacement effect for 1 minute (attacks against you have disadvantage) as a reaction. Its tentacles (2d6+3 bludgeoning each, two attacks) can assist its owner in combat once per short rest.

unlocks.condition: Avoid at least 5 attacks in a single fight thanks to the cub's displacement, or survive a fight that left you below 10 hit points while it was active.

unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, release a thunderclap in a 15-ft radius: 2d6 thunder damage (DC 16 Constitution save for half), and creatures that fail are pushed 10 ft.

legacySource.name: Voidsteel Tower Shield of the Echo

name: Ring Mail of the Sunblessed
flavorText: Ring mail with links that gleam gold in direct sun, even when the rest of the metal has long since tarnished.
description: AC 7. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Resistance to radiant damage. Undead within 10 ft. of you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Requires attunement.

name: Duskwoven Buckler
flavorText: A small buckler that's noticeably harder to spot the moment the sun starts going down.
description: +2 AC. While in dim light or darkness, you are heavily obscured to creatures more than 10 ft. away. Advantage on Stealth checks in shadow. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Hide from a hunting party for a full night while they search for you within 100 ft, wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when a creature targets you with an attack or spell while you are in dim light or darkness, you step sideways into shadow: the attack misses and you teleport to an unoccupied space within 15 ft.

name: Sunsteel Circlet of the Whisper
flavorText: A sun-forged circlet that sits a little too attentively, like it's listening for something even when its wearer isn't.
description: +1 AC. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

name: Ring Mail of the Duskwoven
flavorText: Ring mail that reads a shade darker in twilight than it does at noon, for no reason anyone's identified.
description: AC 7. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. While in dim light or darkness, you are heavily obscured to creatures more than 10 ft. away. Advantage on Stealth checks in shadow. Requires attunement.

name: Thoughtwoven Leather Armor
flavorText: Leather armor stitched with thread that catches light strangely, like it's reacting to something nobody else in the room can sense.
description: AC 5 + Dexterity modifier. Light armor. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

name: Cognizant Chain Shirt
flavorText: A chain shirt that seems to settle differently depending on who's nearby, as if it has opinions about company.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

name: Storm Padded Armor (Cursed)
flavorText: Padded armor that crackles faintly with static at all times — useful in a fight, considerably less useful for staying unnoticed.
description: AC 5 + Dexterity modifier. Light armor. Resistance to lightning damage. Once per long rest, when struck in melee, discharge 2d6 lightning damage to the attacker. Metal objects within 5 ft. of the bearer crackle with static — Stealth checks are made at disadvantage while worn. Requires attunement.

name: Aegis-Marked Breastplate (Cursed)
flavorText: A breastplate marked with the same warding sigil as several of its siblings, etched just a little deeper than the rest.
description: AC 7 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. +2 bonus to saving throws against spells, and advantage on saves against being Petrified. The warding sigils flare painfully whenever a spell targets the bearer, dealing them 1 psychic damage even on a successful save. Requires attunement.

name: Umbral Studded Leather Armor
flavorText: Studded leather dyed a black that seems to deepen, rather than fade, the dimmer the room gets.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier. Light armor. While in dim light or darkness, you are heavily obscured to creatures more than 10 ft. away. Advantage on Stealth checks in shadow. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Hide from a hunting party for a full night while they search for you within 100 ft, wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when a creature targets you with an attack or spell while you are in dim light or darkness, you step sideways into shadow: the attack misses and you teleport to an unoccupied space within 15 ft.

name: Sunsteel Plate Armor of the Whisper
flavorText: Sun-forged plate armor that reacts half a beat before its wearer does, every time something's about to go wrong.
description: AC 9. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand a full night watch alone at a gate, bridge, or camp, and let no one pass unseen.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a charm or fear effect, you shout a warning: the ally has advantage on the save, and you can end the frightened condition on them.

legacySource.name: Sunsteel Plate Armor of the Whisper

name: Cape of the Runescribed
flavorText: A cape with warding script sewn into the lining, in a hand nobody currently alive can read.
description: +2 bonus to saving throws against spells, and advantage on saves against being Petrified. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Walk through a mage's trapped corridor or a warded vault wearing it, and survive every ward.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you or an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a spell, grant the target resistance to the spell's damage and advantage on the saving throw against it.

name: Lucky Hide Armor
flavorText: Hide armor that's outlasted several much better-made pieces, for reasons nobody's ever pinned down.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. Once per long rest, reroll a failed saving throw and use either result. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Win 5 separate wagers or games of chance worth at least 500 gp each while wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft fails a saving throw, they reroll it and use the new result.

name: Starmetal Splint Armor of the Gale
flavorText: Splint armor forged from fallen-star metal that, against all sense, moves lighter than it looks.
description: AC 9. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you take no falling damage from a fall of 30 feet or less. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Survive a fall of at least 60 ft while wearing it, unharmed or at least still standing.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you fall or are knocked prone, catch the wind: you take no damage and land on your feet, and each creature within 5 ft is pushed back 5 ft.

legacySource.name: Starmetal Splint Armor of the Gale

name: Adamantine Hide Armor of the Void
flavorText: Hide armor with a faint shimmer along the seams that only shows up once the room goes properly dark.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. You have advantage on saving throws against being Blinded, Deafened, or Stunned, and can see through magical darkness as if it were dim light. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Shake off 5 separate blinding, deafening, or stunning effects while wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you or an ally within 30 ft is Blinded, Deafened, or Stunned, end that condition on the target immediately.

legacySource.name: Adamantine Hide Armor of the Void

name: Sunsteel Greaves of the Decay
flavorText: Greaves forged from sun-bright metal that somehow still carries a faint graveyard chill underneath.
description: Resistance to necrotic damage. Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP, instead drop to 1 HP. Requires attunement.

name: Stargazer's Breastplate
flavorText: A breastplate that never seems to gather dust — as if the void it was forged near kept it clean on its own.
description: AC 7 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. You have advantage on saving throws against being Blinded, Deafened, or Stunned, and can see through magical darkness as if it were dim light. Requires attunement.

name: Venomfang Leather Armor
flavorText: Leather armor tanned with something that's left a permanent bitter edge to its smell.
description: AC 5 + Dexterity modifier. Light armor. Resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned. Requires attunement.

name: Deathly Gloves
flavorText: Gloves that feel a little too cold for the weather, every single time they're put on.
description: Resistance to necrotic damage. Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP, instead drop to 1 HP. Requires attunement.

name: Sunsteel Chain Mail of the Whisper
flavorText: Chain mail that seems to tighten slightly the moment danger gets close, well before its wearer consciously notices it.
description: AC 8. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

legacySource.name: Sunsteel Chain Mail of the Whisper

name: Glyphguard Gloves
flavorText: Gloves stamped with a ward-glyph clearly copied from somewhere official. The copy still works.
description: +2 bonus to saving throws against spells, and advantage on saves against being Petrified. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Succeed on 5 saving throws against hostile spells while wearing it, tallied across encounters.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you or an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a spell, grant the target resistance to the spell's damage and advantage on the saving throw against it.

name: Ring Mail of the Winterkissed
flavorText: Ring mail that frosts over faintly whenever the temperature drops, whether or not its wearer actually feels the cold.
description: AC 7. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Resistance to cold damage. You and your gear are unaffected by extreme cold and never need to check for frostbite. Requires attunement.

name: Celestine Chain Shirt
flavorText: A chain shirt with links that catch a faint cold light, visible only once every other light source is gone.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. You have advantage on saving throws against being Blinded, Deafened, or Stunned, and can see through magical darkness as if it were dim light. Requires attunement.

name: Sunblessed Shield (Cursed)
flavorText: A shield that catches and holds morning light longer than physics has any business allowing.
description: +3 AC. Resistance to radiant damage. Undead within 10 ft. of you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. The bearer glows faintly at all times (even in darkness) and can never benefit from being Invisible or from Darkness-based concealment. Requires attunement.

name: Dragonbone Half Plate Armor of the Tide
flavorText: Half-plate cut from dragonbone that smells faintly of the ocean no matter how far inland it travels.
description: AC 7 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. You can breathe underwater and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Dive to the bed of a sea or lake at least 100 ft deep wearing it, and bring something up from the bottom.
unlocks.reward: While you are submerged or standing in water you have resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage and cannot be moved against your will. Once per short rest, as a reaction when a creature hits you, a wave breaks over the attacker and pushes it 10 ft away.

legacySource.name: Dragonbone Half Plate Armor of the Tide

name: Wind-Runner's Half Plate Armor
flavorText: Half-plate from the same courier tradition as its matching helm — built for someone who was always, somehow, already gone.
description: AC 7 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. +2 bonus to initiative rolls, and difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Outrun a mounted rider or pursuing pack over at least 5 miles on foot wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you are hit by an attack, move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks; the attack still hits.

name: Sunsteel Leather Armor of the Void
flavorText: Leather armor with a strange starlit sheen that makes no sense for something tanned entirely on solid ground.
description: AC 5 + Dexterity modifier. Light armor. You have advantage on saving throws against being Blinded, Deafened, or Stunned, and can see through magical darkness as if it were dim light. Requires attunement.

legacySource.name: Sunsteel Leather Armor of the Void

name: Bracers of the Gloomforged
flavorText: Bracers forged in a smithy that, by the smith's own account, never once saw proper daylight.
description: While in dim light or darkness, you are heavily obscured to creatures more than 10 ft. away. Advantage on Stealth checks in shadow. Requires attunement.

name: Tempest Boots
flavorText: Boots with soles that spark faintly against stone, like they're still carrying a little of the storm that forged them.
description: Resistance to lightning damage. Once per long rest, when struck in melee, discharge 2d6 lightning damage to the attacker. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand on an exposed summit or open plain during a thunderstorm wearing it until lightning strikes you.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you are hit by a melee attack, discharge: the attacker takes 2d6 lightning damage and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

name: Dragonbone Circlet of the Dawn
flavorText: A dragonbone circlet inlaid with gold that seems to warm at sunrise, regardless of the actual weather.
description: +1 AC. Resistance to radiant damage. Undead within 10 ft. of you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be hit by 3 critical hits across your adventures while wearing this armor, and remain standing after each one.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you glow with dawn light for 1 minute: shed bright light in a 20-ft radius, and undead and fiends that start their turn there take 2d6 radiant damage.

name: Buckler of the Thornwoven
flavorText: A small buckler braided from living bramble rather than metal, and still, somehow, holding a line.
description: +2 AC. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, regrow 2d6 hit points from living plant matter within reach. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Spend three nights outdoors wearing it, sleeping on bare earth, and keep a living plant alive on the road throughout.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as an action, plant roots into the ground: for 1 minute you regain 2d6 hit points at the start of each of your turns while you stand still, and enemies must succeed on a DC 16 Strength save to move you.

name: Gilt-Edged Circlet (Cursed)
flavorText: A gilded circlet that's turned more than one failed roll into a success — and, just as often, the reverse.
description: +1 AC. Once per long rest, reroll a failed saving throw and use either result. Once per long rest, the DM secretly forces you to reroll a SUCCESSFUL roll of their choice and take the new result — the item's luck runs both ways. Requires attunement.

name: Sunsteel Helm of the Venom (Cursed)
flavorText: A sun-forged helm with a faint greenish tarnish spreading slowly across the browplate, no matter how often it's polished away.
description: +1 AC. Resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned. The bearer's own blood thins with residual toxin — disadvantage on death saving throws. Requires attunement.

name: Adamantine Tower Shield of the Deep Frost
flavorText: An adamantine tower shield cold enough that gloves are recommended before carrying it bare-handed.
description: +4 AC. Resistance to cold damage. You and your gear are unaffected by extreme cold and never need to check for frostbite. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Spend three nights in freezing weather wearing it, without a fire for warmth.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you take damage, rime flashes over you: reduce the damage by 12, and the attacker's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

legacySource.name: Adamantine Tower Shield of the Deep Frost

name: Scimitar of Speed
flavorText: A curved blade so perfectly balanced it seems to move before the wielder decides to swing it.
description: +2 to damage rolls. You can make one attack with this scimitar as a bonus action on each of your turns. Requires attunement.

name: Mirror of Life Trapping
flavorText: A tall, ornate mirror in a gilded frame, its surface a little too still to be simple glass.
description: Any creature that sees its own reflection in this mirror must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma save or be drawn inside, trapped in one of twelve extradimensional cells until released by the mirror's owner. Up to 12 creatures can be held at once.

name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
flavorText: A set of four horseshoes, each impossibly light and faintly warm, as though touched by open sky.
description: Sold as a set of four and fitted to a single mount's hooves, these horseshoes grant the mount a flying speed equal to its walking speed, and its hooves make no sound at all, mundane or magical.

name: Sword of Sharpness
flavorText: A longsword honed to an edge that doesn't so much cut as simply agree to no longer be attached.
description: On an attack roll of 20 against a creature that has at least one limb, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. If this reduces it to 0 HP, the blow severs one of its limbs (DM's choice or randomly determined), with all the narrative and mechanical consequences that implies. Requires attunement.

name: Animated Shield
flavorText: A round shield that, once bonded to its bearer, no longer needs a hand to hold it up.
description: +2 AC. As a bonus action, command the shield to animate and hover in front of you (retaining its AC bonus) or return to a normal held shield — while it's animated, both your hands are free. Requires attunement.

name: Staff of the Magi
flavorText: A long staff of black wood. Absorbs spells, holds 50 charges.
description: 50 charges. +2 to damage rolls. Spell Absorption (reaction): absorb spell cast at you, regain equal spell levels. Spells: Conjure Elemental (7), Dispel Magic (3), Fireball 7th (7), Flaming Sphere (2), Ice Storm (4), Invisible Stalker (7), Knock (2), Lightning Bolt 7th (7), Passwall (5), Plane Shift (7), Telekinesis (5), Wall of Fire (4), Web (2). Retributive Strike: break staff, 16d6 force 30-ft. Recharges 4d6+2 charges each day. Requires attunement (sorcerer, warlock, wizard).

unlocks.condition: Absorb a spell with Spell Absorption and use the recovered levels to cast something decisive, 3 times.
unlocks.reward: Spell Absorption can now absorb spells up to 10th level in effective power, and the staff regains 2d8+2 charges at dawn instead of 2d6+2.

name: The Sovereign's Casket
flavorText: A gilded casket bearing a crest no living house claims anymore, its lock a mechanism of interlocking gold teeth that shouldn't still turn after all this time — and does.
description: Open to find a haul of legendary-tier loot and coin.

name: Emberfang, the Wyrmslayer Blade
flavorText: A massive greatsword forged from the fang of an ancient red wyrm and quenched in its own blood.
description: +4 to damage rolls. +2d6 fire damage against dragons and dragonkin. When a true dragon is within 100 ft., the blade hums and the hilt scales bristle. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Deal 500 total fire damage using this weapon across any number of encounters.
unlocks.reward: +1d6 fire damage permanently on all hits. The blade stays visibly orange-hot for 10 minutes after each kill.

unlocks.condition: Kill a true dragon (CR 10+) with this blade as the killing blow.
unlocks.reward: Dragon Terror Aura: all dragons within 60 ft. make DC 16 Wisdom save or become Frightened until they leave the radius. You are permanently immune to dragon Frightful Presence.

unlocks.condition: Kill 3 true dragons with this blade as the killing blow. The third dragon's soul is consumed.
unlocks.reward: The blade becomes Sentient (Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 18) and craves dragon blood. If no dragon is killed within 30 days, it attacks allies. When fed: advantage on all attack rolls for 1 hour after each dragon kill. +5 attack and damage against dragons permanently.

name: Widow's Whisper
flavorText: A slender rapier engraved with a name that has been scratched out.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Attacks with this blade are completely silent. If the wielder knowingly lies while holding it, the blade rings once with a mournful note. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Win 10 single-combat duels (one-on-one, no ally intervention) using this blade.
unlocks.reward: Whisper's Edge: attacks with this weapon cannot be parried. +1d4 psychic damage on every hit.

unlocks.condition: Carve the name of a living target into the blade's flat while speaking their name aloud.
unlocks.reward: Against your Marked Target: +3d8 piercing damage, attacks made with advantage, they cannot become invisible within 1 mile of you. You always know their direction and distance. Mark resets only on their death.

unlocks.condition: Kill the person you loved most. Must be a genuine relationship recognized by the GM.
unlocks.reward: +5 to all attack and damage rolls with this weapon. You can no longer lie in any form — the blade rings and the truth is spoken in your voice. Cannot remove attunement without a Wish spell.

name: Thornmaul
flavorText: A warhammer grown from petrified heartwood of a corrupted treant.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Critical hit: thorny vines erupt from the wound, rooting the target until end of their next turn (DC 18 Strength to end early). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 15 plant-type creatures or treants with this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Root choice on hit: Restrain target (1d8 piercing per turn, DC 16 Strength action to escape). Roots persist even if you drop the weapon.

unlocks.condition: Bring this weapon to a corrupted or dying ancient forest and let a druid or nature deity witness you striking a living tree with it.
unlocks.reward: The maul awakens. Speak with Plants and Commune with Nature simultaneously as a 1-minute ritual, once per day. +2 to attack and damage (total +6). Empathic communication with plants within 60 ft.

unlocks.condition: Strike down an innocent creature sheltering beneath a living tree, knowingly.
unlocks.reward: You take 1d4 piercing damage when gripping the weapon. Critical hits now entangle ALL creatures within 20 ft. +2d8 piercing on critical hits. Difficult terrain of vines appears within 15 ft. of any creature you kill.

name: The Last Word
flavorText: An elven longbow strung with a lock of hair from a dying god.
description: +4 to damage rolls. The nocked arrow seeks the first creature to have drawn the wielder's blood this combat (advantage on this attack). Requires attunement by an elf.

unlocks.condition: Kill 10 creatures using this bow without speaking a word during those encounters. Complete silence.
unlocks.reward: Arrows are completely silent — including impact. Advantage on Stealth while holding this bow and not speaking. Cannot be heard when nocking an arrow.

unlocks.condition: Draw this bow in the presence of a deity or divine avatar (CR 20+) and loose an arrow at them.
unlocks.reward: Against creatures with Legendary Resistance: hits reduce their remaining uses by 1. Once per day: silence a spell being verbalized — the spell fails with no slot expended.

unlocks.condition: Spend a full long rest in quiet at the grave, relic site, or final resting place of the god whose hair strings this bow.
unlocks.reward: The bow speaks one word to you — the name of the thing you most fear losing. Once per week: loose an arrow that cannot miss any named target on any plane — it travels around corners, through walls, across planes if needed.

name: Grudgebearer
flavorText: A dwarven battleaxe carried by seven generations of mountain kings.
description: +4 to damage rolls. For each unhealed wound the wielder carries: +1d6 extra damage (max +3d6). The axe is warm when the bearer is being lied to. Requires attunement by a dwarf.

unlocks.condition: Carry at least 3 unhealed wounds simultaneously and win a combat encounter.
unlocks.reward: The +1d6 per unhealed wound cap (previously +3d6) is removed — no limit on stacking. The blade permanently smells of old iron.

unlocks.condition: Engrave 5 or more names of enemies you have personally defeated or sworn to defeat into the haft using the axe's blade.
unlocks.reward: Against any named creature: +2d10 damage per hit. Reducing a named target to 0 HP restores 10 HP to you. The axe pulses when any named creature is within 30 ft.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The Grudge That Eats (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Spare someone whose name is on the haft — fully and knowingly — in front of witnesses.
unlocks.reward: +4 attack and damage permanently. However: any creature you reduce to 0 HP dies outright — no stabilizing, no prisoners. This cannot be undone while attuned.

name: Nightsong (Paired Daggers)
flavorText: A matched pair of curved daggers forged by shadow-dancers who worked only by moonlight.
description: +4 to damage rolls each. Finesse, light. Once per short rest: teleport up to 10 ft. to any area of dim light or darkness within sight. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Perform 20 Sneak Attacks or hidden hits using these daggers.
unlocks.reward: Teleport range increases from 10 to 30 ft. Destination now includes any shadow cast by a Medium or larger creature. Darkvision 120 ft. and see through magical darkness while both daggers are drawn.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Choir of Blades
unlocks.condition: Kill 5 named NPCs using both daggers in the same encounter within the same night.
unlocks.reward: When you teleport, bring one willing creature of your size or smaller. Hear hostile intent half a second before a blow — advantage on initiative, cannot be surprised while both daggers are drawn.

unlocks.condition: Accept a contract to kill someone, then refuse to complete it after accepting payment.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned — cannot remove voluntarily. On a killing blow: all creatures within 30 ft. make DC 16 Wisdom save or are Frightened. On a kill: absorb one of the target's proficiencies for 24 hours. Cannot be charmed.

name: Bonecrusher, the Giant's Toy
flavorText: An enormous maul once belonging to a hill giant chieftain, later cursed and abandoned.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Critical hit: target knocked prone, ground cracks in 10-ft radius (difficult terrain). Heavy, two-handed. Requires attunement by a creature with Strength 20+.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 5 giants using this weapon.
unlocks.reward: +4d6 bludgeoning on hits against giants. Giants you kill cannot be resurrected or raised as undead — their bones crumble to gravel.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a giant clan's chieftain in single combat and claim their title by tradition.
unlocks.reward: Giant's Decree: once per day, giants within 120 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom save or obey one command for 1 round. Giants who fail have disadvantage on attacks against you permanently.

unlocks.condition: Tell a genuinely funny joke while wielding this weapon in front of at least 5 witnesses who all laugh involuntarily.
unlocks.reward: The maul's low rattling chuckle is constant and audible within 30 ft. — cannot be stealthy. In exchange: on a critical hit, all enemies within 30 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom save or spend their next action laughing (Incapacitated).

name: The Fair Warning
flavorText: A masterwork siege crossbow that ended a famous siege with a single bolt from three hundred yards.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Range 200/800. The first bolt fired each day cannot miss (automatic hit). Loading: bonus action required. Two-handed. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Fire the opening shot in 5 different military conflicts or sieges, witnessed by at least 10 combatants.
unlocks.reward: Range increases to 400/1600. The no-miss bolt can also pin targets to surfaces — Restrained until bolt removed (DC 17 Strength action).

unlocks.condition: Fire the bolt that ends a war — witnessed by leaders of both sides, precipitating peace or surrender.
unlocks.reward: No-miss bolt upgrades: can curve around full cover and hit targets not in line of sight, if seen within 10 minutes. Creatures killed cannot be resurrected without a Wish spell.

unlocks.condition: Refuse to fire when given a clear shot at a primary enemy (tyrant, lich, dragon in range) when the GM signals the moment.
unlocks.reward: Future no-miss shots require DC 15 Wisdom save or fire at nearest creature regardless of allegiance. In exchange: every kill visible to allies grants them 5 temporary HP.

name: Frosthowl
flavorText: A greatsword of blue-white steel, always rimed with frost.
description: +4 to damage rolls, +2d8 cold damage on hit. Target's speed halved until end of their next turn. Wielder immune to cold damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Spend 7 consecutive days in extreme cold (below -30°F) without magical protection, while attuned.
unlocks.reward: Movement in snow/ice +10 ft. Immune to the Slowed condition from cold. Target's speed reduction from hits lasts until end of their next turn OR until they deal fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Kill 10 wolves or winter wolves. On the 10th, let the wolf see you clearly before it dies — do not strike from hiding.
unlocks.reward: Once per day: summon 4 Winter Wolves for 1 hour. While the pack is present, all cold damage from you or the wolves ignores resistance.

unlocks.condition: Challenge and defeat a Winter Wolf Elder (CR 8+) or Frost Giant Jarl in single combat — no allies may assist.
unlocks.reward: Exalted state. Cone of Cold (DC 18, 12d8) usable twice per day. Cold damage ignores immunity. You permanently sprout subtle wolf-like features while attuned.

name: Coinsplitter (Twin Shortswords)
flavorText: A pair of short swords forged from melted-down coins.
description: +4 to damage rolls each. Finesse, light. Once per day: a successful hit also pickpockets one small item from the target (GM discretion). Requires attunement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Sleight of the Blade
unlocks.condition: Successfully steal 1,000 gp total value using these blades' pickpocket ability, across any hits.
unlocks.reward: Pickpocket now lifts any item the target carries — including weapons, foci, or spell components. Once per day, a hit also duplicates one gold coin from the target's pouch.

unlocks.condition: Sell 5,000 gp worth of stolen goods to the same fence or black market contact over multiple sessions.
unlocks.reward: Coin Magnetism: aware of all currency within 30 ft. Cannot be robbed. Gold you spend has 10% chance (roll d10, on 10) to return to your purse by end of day.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The House Always Wins (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Gamble away at least 500 gp in one session and lose it all intentionally — knowing you will lose.
unlocks.reward: Luck Inversion: enemy critical hits against you become normal hits. However: gold above 100 gp disappears at end of each long rest — taken by the swords' original owner.

name: Aegis of the Last Stand
flavorText: Plate armor forged from the melted shields of a hundred knights who held a doomed line.
description: AC 13. Once per long rest: if reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead (armor rings audibly for 1 mile). Resistance to all damage while at 1–20 HP. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be reduced to 0 HP, survive using the armor's 1 HP ability, and remain standing until the end of that combat.
unlocks.reward: The save-from-0-HP ability now triggers twice per long rest. When it triggers, the bell-ring grants all allies within 60 ft. 1d10 temporary HP.

unlocks.condition: Protect an ally from lethal damage 10 times — step between them and an attack that would have killed them.
unlocks.reward: Resistance to all damage while below 50 HP. Once per long rest as a reaction: take all remaining damage from an attack that would kill an ally — they drop to 1 HP instead.

unlocks.condition: Survive a battle where at least 5 allies die and you do not flee — be the last one standing, surrounded by enemies.
unlocks.reward: Cannot die while any ally within 30 ft. is conscious. When finally the last one standing: all enemies within 60 ft. take 10d10 radiant (no save). You choose to die or survive at 1 HP. Fallen allies' names etch inside the armor.

name: Cloak of the Hundred Faces
flavorText: A spymaster's cloak sewn from a hundred discarded illusions.
description: Alter apparent face and voice at will (no action). True Seeing of 8th level or higher only can penetrate this disguise. Occasionally shows a random stranger's face in reflections. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Maintain a single disguise for 30 consecutive in-game days without being discovered by any NPC who knew you before.
unlocks.reward: Perfectly replicate voice, mannerisms, and phrasing of anyone you've spoken with for 10+ minutes. Insight checks against your disguise have disadvantage even against Truesight of 7th level or lower.

unlocks.condition: Successfully impersonate 10 different named NPCs, each convincingly enough that they're fooled.
unlocks.reward: Stored faces held permanently. Switch between any stored face as a bonus action. Access surface memories of that person — their name, occupation, family, and last action. Feel their emotions faintly.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The Hundred Become One (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Go 10 consecutive in-game days without speaking or writing your own name — not even in private.
unlocks.reward: Your original face is gone. The cloak cycles through stored faces randomly while you sleep. +4 Charisma. Those who knew you feel unsettled even seeing your original face — they sense something is wrong but cannot articulate it.

name: Ironhide Vestments
flavorText: Chain from the hide of an ironback boar that took a village three days to bring down.
description: AC 9. Resistance to piercing damage. Makes a low grunt when the wearer is startled or surprised. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be struck by 50 total piercing attacks while wearing this armor (cumulative).
unlocks.reward: Immunity to mundane piercing weapons (non-magical). Resistance to slashing damage added. The grunt gives 1 round of advance warning before ambushes.

unlocks.condition: Press this armor against the blood of a freshly killed boar or large beast once per month for 3 consecutive months.
unlocks.reward: Gore attack (1d10+Str, bonus action). On a charge (20+ ft. straight): 3d10+Str instead. AC increases to 19. While below half HP: all attacks deal +2d6 piercing damage.

unlocks.condition: Refuse to retreat from 5 separate encounters where retreat would have been tactically correct, surviving each one.
unlocks.reward: Cannot flee — movement away from nearest enemy costs double. In exchange: resistance to all damage while you haven't moved more than 10 ft. in the previous round. +2 AC when you don't move on your turn.

name: Shield of the Unbroken Line
flavorText: A tower shield passed down an unbroken line of border-guard captains for three centuries.
description: +3 AC (on top of standard shield bonus — total +5 AC from this shield). Once per day: as a reaction, reduce one attack's damage to 0. A new notch appears on the rim each time this triggers. The shield has never been broken and is immune to the Shatter spell. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the shield's damage-reduction reaction 10 times.
unlocks.reward: Reaction now usable twice per day. When triggered, allies within 10 ft. also take 0 damage from the same attack (not just half).

unlocks.condition: Carry this shield into 3 different wars, sieges, or declared military conflicts.
unlocks.reward: The Line Holds: while you haven't moved this round, you and all allies within 10 ft. have resistance to all damage. Moving ends this effect until your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Stand between an unarmed civilian and certain death, take the killing blow yourself, and survive — the civilian must live.
unlocks.reward: AC bonus increases to +4. Once per long rest: create a 30-ft wall of force lasting 1 minute — all attacks against creatures behind it miss automatically. The shield names itself and will tell you in a dream.

name: Boots of the Wanderer King
flavorText: Worn by a king who walked away from his own coronation.
description: Never fatigued from walking. Always sense direction of nearest settlement. Ignore non-magical difficult terrain. No attunement required.

unlocks.condition: Travel more than 500 miles from where you started your adventuring career while wearing these boots.
unlocks.reward: Your walking speed increases by 10 ft. while wearing them, and you no longer need food or water while traveling (you still benefit from consuming them if available).

unlocks.condition: Visit 10 settlements you have never set foot in before while wearing these boots.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, sense the direction and rough distance to any specific place or person you have previously visited or met, not just the nearest settlement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The King Never Rests (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Go 30 consecutive days without sleeping in the same location twice.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. You cannot be tracked by non-magical means and are immune to exhaustion caused by travel, but you gain disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened while indoors within a building you own or call home.

name: Gauntlets of the Iron Handshake
flavorText: Forged for a diplomat famous for ending a war with a spine-cracking handshake.
description: Unarmed strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage. Advantage on Strength (Athletics) grapple checks. Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) when threatening physical force. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Win 10 grapple or shove contests while wearing these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Unarmed strike damage increases to 1d10 bludgeoning. Advantage on checks and saves to resist being grappled, restrained, or shoved.

unlocks.condition: Successfully intimidate 15 different creatures while wearing these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, a successful unarmed strike can stun the target until the end of its next turn (DC 15 Constitution save negates).

unlocks.condition: Reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an unarmed strike from these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. Your unarmed strikes count as magical and deal an extra 1d6 damage, but you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks — people who've heard what your hands can do don't relax around you.

name: Helm of the Second Sight
flavorText: Worn by an oracle who saw her own death three times and changed the outcome each time.
description: +1 AC. Advantage on initiative rolls. Cannot be surprised while wearing it. Once per day: before making an initiative roll, you may declare you act first this round (overrides normal initiative order). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the helm's act-first ability in 5 different encounters where you were not the highest initiative.
unlocks.reward: Act-first ability upgrades to twice per day. Once per day, the GM gives a cryptic single-sentence hint about what will happen in the next encounter before it begins.

unlocks.condition: Deliberately allow a future you foresaw to happen without attempting to prevent it, and let it play out.
unlocks.reward: True Prophecy once per week: meditate 1 hour, the GM describes one event in specific detail occurring within 7 in-game days. You cannot change this event — but you can prepare.

unlocks.condition: Witness your own death in a vision and accept it without attempting to deny or prevent it.
unlocks.reward: Truesight 60 ft. permanently. Once per day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the future — they must answer honestly. Once per long rest: rewind 6 seconds for the entire battlefield (everyone retains memory of what happened).

name: Robes of the Still Storm
flavorText: Woven by a monastic order trained in the eye of a hurricane.
description: +2 AC. Immune to the Prone condition and cannot be moved against your will by wind, gust, or force effects. When a creature hits you with a melee attack: you can use your reaction to force them to make a DC 16 Strength save or be pushed back 10 ft. The hem moves at all times regardless of air. Requires attunement by a monk or druid.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Eye of the Storm
unlocks.condition: Maintain concentration on a spell for its full maximum duration in 10 separate encounters while taking damage each time.
unlocks.reward: Concentration spells last twice as long (up to their listed max, then doubled). Once per encounter: automatically succeed one Constitution save to maintain concentration.

unlocks.condition: Find and spend one week in meditation at the storm-wracked mountain monastery where these robes were woven.
unlocks.reward: Tempest Form once per day for 1 minute: partially incorporeal (immune to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing). Constant Gust of Wind 30-ft radius. Move through other creatures' spaces. Ignore difficult terrain.

unlocks.condition: Strike a monk or druid engaged in peaceful meditation without warning while they are defenseless.
unlocks.reward: Constant thunder aura — cannot be stealthy. In exchange: while Incorporeal, melee attackers take 2d8 thunder damage. Spells deal +2d6 thunder. Immune to thunder and lightning damage.

name: Elixir of the Phoenix's Breath
flavorText: Distilled from a single feather shed willingly by a phoenix.
description: Restores 10d4+20 HP. If used on a creature at 0 HP: they rise wreathed in harmless warm flame for one round. Action to use on an unconscious ally.

unlocks.condition: Use an Elixir of the Phoenix's Breath (or another found later) to stabilize or revive an ally on 3 separate occasions.
unlocks.reward: Future uses restore an additional 2d4 HP, and the harmless warm flame grants the target resistance to fire damage for 1 minute.

unlocks.condition: Use the elixir on an ally who was reduced to 0 HP by fire damage.
unlocks.reward: When used on a creature at 0 HP, that creature also removes one exhaustion level and stands up with 1 temporary hit point that lingers until the start of their next turn.

name: Draught of a Thousand Faces
flavorText: An opalescent potion brewed for a client who was never named.
description: Assume the exact appearance of any humanoid you have seen, for 24 hours. Provides the body — not the voice. Your own accent persists regardless.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Face Worth Keeping
unlocks.condition: Successfully deceive 5 different creatures using a disguise granted by this draught (or another of its kind).
unlocks.reward: The disguise now also alters your voice to match, and lasts for 48 hours instead of 24.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Nobody You've Ever Been
unlocks.condition: Use the draught's disguise to infiltrate a location you could not otherwise have entered.
unlocks.reward: You may now also mimic the exact voice and minor mannerisms of anyone you've spent at least 10 minutes observing, in addition to their appearance.

name: Vial of Borrowed Time
flavorText: A silvery liquid that moves against the current of its vial.
description: Act twice on your next turn (two complete turns worth of actions). Immediately after: gain 1 level of exhaustion.

unlocks.condition: Use a Vial of Borrowed Time to directly turn the tide of a combat you would otherwise likely have lost.
unlocks.reward: The exhaustion level gained afterward is removed automatically after your next short rest instead of requiring a long rest.

unlocks.condition: Use 3 Vials of Borrowed Time within the same 7-day period.
unlocks.reward: You may act twice on your next turn as normal, but immediately after your following turn, you gain 2 levels of exhaustion instead of 1 for that use only.

name: Scroll of the Final Verse
flavorText: A scroll of singing script — the last spell a legendary archmage cast before retiring.
description: Cast any 6th-level spell you have personally witnessed cast, once, without components. The scroll burns away as ash shaped like musical notes.

unlocks.condition: Use the scroll to cast a spell that saves an ally's life.
unlocks.reward: You may cast the spell without needing to have personally witnessed anyone cast it, so long as you know of the spell by name and general effect.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Song Doesn't End
unlocks.condition: Successfully cast 3 different 6th-level spells using scrolls of this kind over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: The musical-note ash the scroll leaves behind can be gathered and used as a divine focus for your next spell cast within 1 minute, granting a +1 bonus to its save DC.

name: Powdered Star-Iron
flavorText: A pouch of silvery dust ground from a fragment of a fallen star.
description: Coat a weapon over 1 minute: +1d6 force damage on hit for 1 hour. Overcomes any resistance or immunity to non-magical damage. Weapon emits a sustained hum while active.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Iron From the Sky
unlocks.condition: Use star-iron-coated weapons to deal a combined 100 damage to creatures normally resistant or immune to non-magical damage.
unlocks.reward: The coating now lasts 8 hours instead of 1, and the bonus damage increases to 1d8.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Weapon Remembers the Stars
unlocks.condition: Coat 5 different weapons with star-iron powder over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: You can now coat two weapons from a single application (yours and one ally's, or two of your own), so long as both are coated within the same minute.

name: Tears of the Unburied Queen
flavorText: A crystal vial of tears wept by a queen who refused to die before finishing her revenge.
description: Restores 6d10+12 HP. Also cures any one curse or disease. The drinker weeps uncontrollably but harmlessly for about a minute.

unlocks.condition: Use the tears to cure a curse or disease on an ally, not yourself.
unlocks.reward: Future uses restore an additional 2d10 HP, and the weeping period no longer causes disadvantage on Perception checks during it.

unlocks.condition: Use 3 vials of these tears over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: The cure effect now also removes one level of exhaustion in addition to curing curses and disease.

name: The Gambler's Last Coin
flavorText: A tarnished coin that has never once landed the way its holder wanted — except when it mattered most.
description: Once per week: reroll any single failed roll (before knowing the outcome). Must accept the new result. Sometimes spins on its edge for exactly ten seconds before falling.

unlocks.condition: Use the coin's reroll ability 10 times and have at least 7 produce a better result than the original.
unlocks.reward: Once per day: reroll any creature's die roll within 60 ft. (yours or theirs) and choose either result. The coin now spins for 15 seconds instead of 10 before falling.

unlocks.condition: Win a wager of at least 500 gp against unfavorable odds without using the coin's ability.
unlocks.reward: Probability Sense: always know approximate odds of any proposed course of action (GM tells you: good, even, poor, or terrible odds). Cannot be cheated at games of chance.

unlocks.condition: Lose a bet in which you staked at least half of your total wealth or a prized possession, without using magic to change the outcome.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: an unknown benefactor provides one service or clears one debt (GM determines form). However: once per month the coin calls in its own favor — GM chooses what you must do. Refusing costs you 3 automatic reroll failures.

name: Signet of the Forgotten House
flavorText: A heavy signet ring bearing the crest of a house erased from every record.
description: +3 AC (ring of protection). Opens any door or lock inscribed with a heraldic crest. Strangers occasionally show unearned deference, then look confused. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Research and document the complete history of the Forgotten House — its name, members, and how it was erased — and present this to a historian or court.
unlocks.reward: Any door, vault, or lock bearing a noble crest opens at your touch. Noble NPCs treat you as a peer regardless of your actual title.

unlocks.condition: Spend at least 1,000 gp to restore, rebuild, or formally re-establish the Forgotten House in some capacity.
unlocks.reward: Gain a loyal retainer from the restored house who cannot be bought, charmed, or deceived into betrayal. Once per day: cast Sending without components to any noble or ruling-class member on the plane.
