unlocks.condition: Have yourself deliberately erased from an official record — your name removed from a census, guild roster, or kingdom's birth records — by your own hand.
unlocks.reward: Creatures who meet you have disadvantage on checks to recall your appearance or name 24 hours later. Once per week: erase one NPC's memory of you completely (DC 18 Wisdom to resist). Your name fades from documents written by others within 1 month.

name: The Hourglass That Lies
flavorText: A palm-sized hourglass whose sand does not fall at a consistent rate.
description: Once per day: rewind the last 6 seconds for yourself alone (limited Timestop equivalent). One grain of sand always falls upward when this happens.

unlocks.condition: Use the 6-second rewind ability 20 times.
unlocks.reward: Rewind now covers 12 seconds (2 rounds). You retain memory of all actions in the rewound period — effective foreknowledge.

unlocks.condition: Find and identify the hourglass's maker — their name, their era, and why they made something that lies about time.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: fast-forward instead of rewind — skip 1 round entirely (your turn doesn't occur, nothing acts against you, you emerge at next round's start fully rid of one condition).

unlocks.condition: Convince someone of a complete falsehood using the hourglass's temporal aura to make the lie feel like memory, so that they reverse a major decision (the DM confirms).
unlocks.reward: The hourglass stops lying. Once per day: see exactly 6 seconds into the future with certainty — not a guess, but true knowledge of what will happen next round in initiative order, including all enemy actions and targets.

name: Compass of the Wayward Star
flavorText: An old brass compass that has never pointed north.
description: Needle always points toward whatever the holder most fears to find. Spins wildly if pointed at the holder's own reflection. Cannot be set to point elsewhere.

unlocks.condition: Use the compass to knowingly walk toward whatever it points at, 5 separate times.
unlocks.reward: You may now ask the compass to instead point toward what you most hope to find, once per long rest, though it may still show what you fear if the two are closely entangled.

unlocks.condition: Confront and overcome the specific thing the compass revealed you feared.
unlocks.reward: The compass no longer spins wildly when pointed at your own reflection — instead it points true north, functioning as a reliable compass whenever you don't need it to be anything more.

name: Mask of the Silent Choir
flavorText: A plain wooden mask worn by a monastery that vowed never to be heard again.
description: +1 AC. The wearer's voice cannot be heard beyond 5 feet unless they choose otherwise. Occasionally hums in perfect harmony with anyone nearby. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Go an entire adventuring day without speaking above a whisper while wearing the mask.
unlocks.reward: You gain advantage on Stealth checks made to avoid being heard, in addition to the mask's existing effects.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Harmony of One
unlocks.condition: Successfully sneak past 10 creatures who should reasonably have heard you, while wearing the mask.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, the mask's hum can be directed at one creature within 30 ft. as an action — DC 15 Wisdom save or that creature is charmed for 1 minute, perceiving the hum as a lullaby.

name: The Debt Collector's Ledger
flavorText: A heavy leather ledger that binds any debt spoken aloud into its pages.
description: Once per month: call in any recorded debt, compelling a single reasonable favor (Geas equivalent, DC 20 Wisdom save to resist). New entries occasionally appear on their own — debts the holder didn't know they owed.

unlocks.condition: Successfully compel 5 favors using the Ledger's Geas ability.
unlocks.reward: Debts can compound into standing obligations — ongoing service instead of a single act. Up to 3 active obligations at once.

unlocks.condition: Collect on a debt from a king, deity, or CR 20+ entity — the favor must actually be delivered.
unlocks.reward: Once per month, the Ledger informs you of one significant obligation a powerful creature (CR 15+) has to the world. You can call it in as if written in your Ledger — they cannot refuse.

unlocks.condition: Forgive a debt — intentionally release someone from an obligation in the Ledger with nothing in return, in genuine goodwill.
unlocks.reward: The Ledger begins recording debts owed to you by the universe. Once per day: spend a debt-credit to declare that something that just failed (a roll, an action) succeeded instead. The universe owed you this one.

name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
flavorText: A massive warhammer with a head the size of a man's chest, inscribed with storm runes.
description: Deals 2d6+1 bludgeoning damage. Giant-slaying: +2d6 additional damage vs. giants. Thrown (range 20/60): returns. On a hit against a giant: DC 17 Constitution save or stunned until end of their next turn. While attuned with Belt of Giant Strength AND Gauntlets of Ogre Power: +5 to damage rolls, giant hit DC 17 Wisdom or Frightened of you for 1 minute. Requires attunement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Thunder Remembers Its Name
unlocks.condition: Score a killing blow against a giant using this hammer.
unlocks.reward: The giant-slaying bonus damage increases to 3d6, and the hammer's thrown range increases to 30/90.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Worthy of the Storm (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Defeat 5 giants total with this hammer.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. On any critical hit, the target is also stunned until the end of its next turn (DC 17 Constitution save negates), but each throw leaves your hands numb — disadvantage on Dexterity checks requiring fine manipulation for 1 minute after each throw.

name: Lyre of Building
flavorText: A silver-strung lyre with a resonant wooden body.
description: Requires attunement by a bard. While playing: structures and objects within 300 ft. are immune to damage from siege weapons and spells. Play for 30 minutes: construction magic — work of up to 100 workers for 24 hours is completed instantly (walls, bridges, buildings). Once per 30 days.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Song for Foundations
unlocks.condition: Play the lyre's protection over a structure while it is attacked by at least 6 hostile creatures or a siege engine, and hold it until the attack ends.
unlocks.reward: The protective radius increases to 500 ft., and structures within it also can't be damaged by natural disasters (fire, flood, earthquake) while you play.

unlocks.condition: Play the lyre to aid construction or repair on 3 separate structures.
unlocks.reward: You may now also use the lyre's construction-aid effect (accelerating repair/building work) even while its damage-immunity effect is not active, as a separate use of the same action.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
flavorText: A brilliant ruby potion that practically glows with life.
description: Restores 10d4+20 hit points. Action to drink.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — More Than the Dose
unlocks.condition: Drink or administer a Potion of Supreme Healing (or another found later) 3 times over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: Future potions of this kind restore an additional 2d4 HP and remove one level of exhaustion.

name: Astral Shard
flavorText: A jagged crystal taken from the Astral Plane that still crackles with psychic energy.
description: Requires attunement by a sorcerer. While holding: and spell save DC. Once per day: when you use a Metamagic option, you can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see (bonus action).

unlocks.condition: Use Metamagic in combination with the shard's damage-boosting ability 10 times.
unlocks.reward: The bonus damage die from the shard's ability increases by one step, and its use is available twice per day instead of once.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Fragment of Somewhere Else
unlocks.condition: Cast a spell of 6th level or higher while holding the shard.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, reduce the sorcery point cost of a Metamagic option by 1 (minimum 1) when used with a spell empowered by the shard.

name: Cauldron of Rebirth (Greater)
flavorText: A massive cauldron of black iron etched with the faces of forgotten heroes.
description: Requires attunement by a druid or cleric. Once per day: cast True Resurrection (no spell slot, no components other than 25,000 gp in diamonds, which the cauldron consumes). Additionally: creatures revived this way return with all their hit points and no exhaustion.

unlocks.condition: Successfully use the cauldron to cast True Resurrection.
unlocks.reward: The diamond dust cost for future castings is reduced by 5,000 gp (minimum 5,000 gp).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Second Chance, Freely Given
unlocks.condition: Use the cauldron to restore a creature who died protecting someone else.
unlocks.reward: Once per year, the cauldron can cast True Resurrection without any material component cost at all, so long as the caster can name the person the deceased died protecting.

name: Crystalline Chronicle
flavorText: An ornate crystal sphere that records and stores spell knowledge.
description: Requires attunement by a wizard. Functions as a spellbook. +2 to spell save DC and spell attack rolls. While holding: can cast one spell from the Chronicle without expending a spell slot once per day. Chronicle holds up to 100 spells.

unlocks.condition: Successfully copy or learn 5 spells into the Chronicle.
unlocks.reward: The spell save DC and spell attack bonus granted increase to +3, and you may prepare one additional spell per long rest while attuned.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Library That Answers Back
unlocks.condition: Successfully cast a spell of 8th level or higher using the Chronicle's stored spells.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, cast any spell of 5th level or lower stored in the Chronicle without expending a spell slot.

name: Far Realm Shard
flavorText: A shard of crystallized unreality taken from the Far Realm. Looking at it too long is inadvisable.
description: Requires attunement by a sorcerer. While holding: +2 to spell save DC. Once per day as a bonus action: when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can have one target take 3d8 psychic damage and become Incapacitated until end of their next turn (DC 15 Intelligence save to negate).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Whisper From Elsewhere
unlocks.condition: Trigger the shard's damage-boosting Metamagic effect 10 times.
unlocks.reward: The bonus damage increases by one die step, and once per long rest the triggered spell also imposes disadvantage on the target's next saving throw.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — It Is Looking Back (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Trigger the shard's effect against a creature native to the Far Realm or a similarly alien plane.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. The shard's bonus is available twice per day, but once per long rest you must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom save or perceive something briefly that unsettles you — disadvantage on your next Wisdom saving throw within the hour.

name: Grimoire Infinitus
flavorText: An enormous spellbook that seems to have no last page.
description: Requires attunement by a wizard. +2 to spell save DC and spell attack rolls. The book has infinite pages — can store unlimited spells. Once per long rest: read aloud from it to cast any spell in it without expending a spell slot (8th level or lower).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — No Page Left Blank
unlocks.condition: Store 10 different spells within the grimoire.
unlocks.reward: You may prepare one additional spell per long rest while attuned, and the grimoire can now hold spells of any level you can cast.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Every Story Ever Written
unlocks.condition: Use the grimoire's stored spells to defeat a creature with legendary actions.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, cast a stored spell of 4th level or lower without expending a spell slot.

name: Obsidian Flint Dragon Plate
flavorText: Full plate armor of volcanic obsidian inlaid with fire dragon scales, impossibly smooth.
description: AC 10. Immunity to fire damage. While wearing: fire breath-like attacks you make deal +2d6 fire damage. As a bonus action: breathe fire in a 30-ft cone — 10d6 fire damage (DC 18 Dex for half). Once per day.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Forged in the Old Fire
unlocks.condition: Survive an attack that would have killed a creature without your fire immunity.
unlocks.reward: Your fire breath attack's damage increases by 2d6, and its recharge becomes available on a short rest instead of only once per long rest.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Plate Remembers the Forge
unlocks.condition: Defeat a dragon or fire-based creature while wearing this armor.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, when you use the bonus-action fire breath, you may do so twice in the same turn (using both your action and bonus action).

name: Rod of the Vonindod
flavorText: A massive iron rod with a crackling crown of electrical energy.
description: +3 to damage rolls (2-handed, bludgeoning). On a critical hit: discharge 12d8 lightning in a 10-ft radius (DC 18 Dex for half). While holding: immune to lightning damage, can sense metallic objects within 60 ft. Once per day: cast Chain Lightning (DC 18, 10d8). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Score 3 critical hits with the rod, triggering its lightning discharge each time.
unlocks.reward: The lightning discharge radius increases to 15 ft., and the save DC increases by 1.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Storm Wants Out (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Trigger the rod's lightning discharge 10 times total.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. The discharge damage increases to 15d8, but each discharge that hits you as well as your enemies (from being within your own radius) can no longer be avoided — you take half damage on a failed save exactly as your enemies do.

name: Hide of the Feral Guardian
flavorText: Tanned hide armor made from the pelt of a celestial beast. Covered in glowing runes.
description: AC 8 + Dex modifier (max 2). Requires attunement by a druid or ranger. While wearing: cast Polymorph (self only, beast form) once per day without concentration — lasts 1 hour. Beast form: maximum challenge rating equal to your level. While transformed: advantage on Perception and Survival checks.

unlocks.condition: Successfully protect an ally from a killing blow while in beast form granted by this armor.
unlocks.reward: You may now cast Polymorph (self only, beast form) twice per long rest instead of once.

unlocks.condition: Spend a combined total of 8 hours in beast form granted by this armor.
unlocks.reward: While in beast form via this armor, you retain the ability to cast spells with only verbal components, in addition to your normal beast-form limitations.

name: Hollow Dragon
flavorText: A hollow figurine of a dragon carved from clear crystal. A tiny heartbeat can be felt through it.
description: Requires attunement. Once per long rest: speak the command word — the figurine shatters, calling the spirit of the dragon it represented. The spirit acts as a draconic ally for 1 hour (statistics of an Adult Dragon of its type, half maximum HP). After 1 hour or when reduced to 0 HP, the spirit departs and the figurine is destroyed.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — The Spirit Answers Faster
unlocks.condition: Summon the dragon spirit and have it survive an entire encounter.
unlocks.reward: The figurine reforms after only 5 days instead of requiring a full long rest cycle, and the summoned spirit arrives with full hit points even if it was reduced low in a previous summoning.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Bond Beyond Shattering
unlocks.condition: Summon the dragon spirit 5 separate times.
unlocks.reward: You may communicate telepathically with the dragon spirit for the duration of its summoning, and it acts on your turn immediately rather than requiring an additional command.

name: Sword of Answering (Wildemount)
flavorText: One of the legendary Vestiges of Divergence — a blade that grows with its wielder.
description: Dormant: +2 to damage rolls. Awakened (over time): +3 to damage rolls, +1d6 radiant damage on hit. Exalted (over time): +3 to damage rolls, +2d6 radiant, advantage on all saving throws. Requires attunement. Grows as the wielder achieves great deeds.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — The Sword Recognizes You
unlocks.condition: Reach the sword's Exalted state through its normal awakening process, and win a battle against a creature of CR 10 or higher while wielding it.
unlocks.reward: Once Exalted, the radiant damage increases to 3d6, and the sword's bonus to attack and damage persists even if you are momentarily disarmed and immediately reclaim it (within 1 minute).

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Voice That Answers Back
unlocks.condition: Carry the sword, Exalted, through 3 more battles against creatures of CR 10 or higher.
unlocks.reward: The sword can now speak a short warning to you (as a free action on its part) when you are about to be surprised or ambushed, once per long rest.

name: The Wandering Tower
flavorText: A miniature iron tower that fits in the palm of your hand, cold to the touch, with tiny lights visible in the windows.
description: Once per day: place it on a surface — it expands to a 20-ft square, 60-ft tall stone tower with 4 floors, crenelations, and an iron door only you can open from outside. Fully furnished. Command word to collapse it (must be unoccupied). 30 creatures can shelter inside comfortably.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Home That Follows
unlocks.condition: Shelter at least 4 allies inside the tower while it is pursued, stormed, or attacked by at least 6 hostile creatures, and hold until the threat leaves.
unlocks.reward: The tower gains a 5th floor with a small kitchen and washroom, and can now be summoned as a bonus action instead of an action.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Rooms It Didn't Have Before
unlocks.condition: Use the tower as a base of operations for at least 7 in-game days.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, one door on the ground floor can be designated to open onto a location you have previously visited, functioning as a one-way Teleportation Circle for that use only.

name: Calamity Blade
flavorText: A greatsword of ancient make, forged during the Age of Arcanum. The blade is covered in tiny fracture lines that glow red when drawn.
description: +3 to damage rolls. On a hit: deal +2d6 force damage. On a critical hit: the target must make DC 17 Constitution save or have one of their ability scores reduced by 1d4 (your choice which) until they complete a long rest. Requires attunement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — The Blade Remembers the Score
unlocks.condition: Reduce 5 different creatures' ability scores using the blade's critical hit effect.
unlocks.reward: The critical save DC increases to 19, and a failed save now reduces the ability score by 1d6 instead of 1d4.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Calamity Answers to No One (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Trigger the blade's critical effect against 10 different creatures total.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned — cannot be removed voluntarily. The force damage on every hit increases to 3d6, but once per long rest when you score a critical hit, you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or immediately attack the nearest creature (ally or enemy) on your next turn.

name: Adamantine Plate Shield
flavorText: A kite shield of solid adamantine, sized to match a full plate ensemble.
description: +3 AC. While actively blocking, a critical hit against you from the blocked direction is treated as a normal hit instead. Requires attunement.

name: Sworn Bronze Wyrmling
flavorText: A young bronze dragon, not yet full-grown, who has sworn an oath of protection over its chosen companion for reasons it considers private.
description: Breath weapon (twice per short rest): 40-ft line, 8d8 lightning damage, DC 17 Dex save for half — usable to defend its owner. Water breathing while nearby. Advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened while it's within 30 ft.

unlocks.condition: Use the wyrmling's breath weapon to hit at least 3 enemies at once in each of 3 separate battles.
unlocks.reward: Breath weapon damage increases to 10d8, usable three times per short rest.

unlocks.condition: Learn the private reason for the wyrmling's oath, from the wyrmling itself, once it finally trusts you enough to say.
unlocks.reward: +2 Charisma. The wyrmling's charm/fear immunity becomes permanent and always-on, extending to a 60-ft radius around it that protects everyone in range, not just itself.

name: Phoenix Chick
flavorText: A newly-hatched phoenix, small and unassuming, faintly warm to the touch, radiating quiet certainty that it cannot really die.
description: Once per long rest, if its owner drops to 0 HP, the chick can expend itself in a burst of restorative flame, fully healing the owner and removing one condition of the owner's choice — then requires a week to be reborn from its own ashes before it can do so again. While alive, it sheds warm light (20 ft.) and grants its owner resistance to fire damage.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Certain It Cannot Die
unlocks.condition: Survive being fully healed by the chick's sacrifice, and see it through its week of rebirth.
unlocks.reward: The chick's restorative flame can now also revive its owner from death (within 1 minute of dying), not just heal them from 0 HP, still requiring a week to be reborn afterward.

unlocks.condition: Carry the chick through its rebirth three times, staying with it each time until it hatches anew.
unlocks.reward: The rebirth period shortens to 24 hours, and its fire resistance extends to a 10-ft radius around its owner.

name: Bound Lantern Archon
flavorText: A small sphere of gentle, ever-present light bound in perpetual service by an old and largely forgotten pact.
description: Sheds bright light 30 ft., dim light 30 ft. beyond, at will. Can cast Daylight once per short rest and Guiding Bolt (4d6 radiant) once per short rest on its owner's behalf. Immune to being surprised by evil-aligned creatures while it's within 30 ft.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Light Against the Dark
unlocks.condition: Defeat 3 separate encounters against undead or fiends in which the archon's light or Guiding Bolt struck the first blow.
unlocks.reward: Guiding Bolt can now be cast twice per short rest, dealing 6d6 radiant, and Daylight no longer requires a rest to recast once its previous casting has ended.

unlocks.condition: Learn the old pact that binds the archon, and choose — with the archon's own input — to renew it freely rather than leave it bound.
unlocks.reward: +2 Wisdom. The archon's immunity to being surprised by evil creatures extends to its owner as well, within 30 ft.

name: Pegasus
flavorText: A winged horse of unmistakably noble bearing, who will only bear a rider it judges to be good at heart.
description: Speed 60 ft., fly speed 90 ft. Rider gains +3 to damage rolls made while mounted and airborne. Advantage on all saving throws against being frightened while mounted. Once per short rest, the pegasus can dive-kick (4d6+5 bludgeoning) to assist the rider.

unlocks.condition: Win a battle fought entirely at least 30 ft above the ground, with the pegasus carrying you.
unlocks.reward: The attack bonus while mounted and airborne increases to +4, and the dive-kick can be used twice per short rest.

unlocks.condition: Give up something worth at least 500 gp (or a prized possession) to help a stranger in need, with no witness but the pegasus.
unlocks.reward: Fly speed increases to 120 ft., and the frightened-immunity while mounted extends to a 30-ft radius around the pegasus, protecting nearby allies too.

name: Bonded Griffon
flavorText: A full-grown griffon, eagle-headed and lion-bodied, bonded for life to one rider it chose itself.
description: Speed 50 ft., fly speed 80 ft. Rider gains +3 to damage rolls while mounted. The griffon fights alongside its rider every round, attacking independently with its own claws and beak (2d6+5 slashing, 2d10+5 piercing) — no per-day limit.

unlocks.condition: Win 3 separate battles in which you and the griffon each protected the other at least once (blocked a blow, drew attacks, or pulled the other out of danger).
unlocks.reward: The attack bonus while mounted increases to +4, and the griffon's claw and beak damage increase to 2d6+6 and 2d10+6.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Bonded for Life, Tested
unlocks.condition: The bond between you and the griffon is tested by a choice that could have ended it, and it doesn't.
unlocks.reward: Speed increases to 60 ft., fly speed to 100 ft., and the griffon now shares a passive Perception advantage with its rider at all times.

name: Scimitar of the Galebound
flavorText: A scimitar that's always a beat ahead of the wind — draw it fast enough and the gust seems to arrive before the swing lands.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Finesse. Once per turn on a hit, a gust adds an extra 2d8 thunder damage and pushes the target 10 ft. directly away from you. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the weapon's gust to shove 6 different creatures off a ledge, out of a window, or into a hazard (a fall of 10+ ft or damaging terrain counts).
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when a ranged attack targets you or an ally within 30 ft, the weapon howls and that attack is made with disadvantage. In addition, when you take the Dash action while holding it, every creature you move past must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be shoved 10 ft.

unlocks.condition: Use this weapon to sunder another magic weapon or magic item, destroying it completely.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, unleash a 30-ft cone of thunder: 6d6 thunder damage (DC 18 Constitution save for half), and each creature that fails is pushed 15 ft and deafened until the end of its next turn. The price: the wind never stops tugging at you — you automatically fail Stealth checks against anything within 60 ft, and torches and candles within 10 ft gutter out.

name: Nalion, the Mindbreaker
flavorText: A black-iron war pick that was buried with its owner — until someone dug it back up. It strikes truer in the dark, when a mind's guard is down.
description: +4 to damage rolls. On a hit while you are in dim light or darkness, deal an extra 2d8 psychic damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a single creature of CR 11 or higher with this weapon while no other creature deals damage to it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action while you are in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a shadow, a nightwalker, or another creature of living darkness of CR 11 or higher while holding it, dealing the killing blow yourself.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, plunge a 30-ft radius around you into magical darkness for 10 minutes (it moves with you). You can see through it, and you have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that cannot.

name: Myrith, the Faithful
flavorText: A battleaxe carried by a courier who outran a plague on foot, armed with nothing but this and good boots. It still remembers how to move fast.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Versatile (1d10+4). Once per turn when you hit with this weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Deliver a sealed message at least 50 miles overland in under 24 hours, on foot, carrying this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, take the Dash or Disengage action. While you hold the weapon, opportunity attacks made against you have disadvantage.

unlocks.condition: Swear a binding oath before a priest or witnesses, then break it while wielding this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, take one additional action on your turn (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, or Hide). The price: every use costs you a level of exhaustion, and you cannot remove exhaustion gained this way except by sleeping a full night in a proper bed.

name: Sileth Grimion, the Burning Vow
flavorText: A curved kukri with a blade that never fully cools. Every grip it's ever had shows old scorch marks.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Finesse. On a hit, the wound cauterizes into flame for an extra 2d8 fire damage. Sheds dim firelight 10 ft. while drawn. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Set 6 different creatures ablaze with this weapon's flame within a single encounter.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, the weapon blazes for 1 minute: bright light in a 30-ft radius, and each creature you hit while it blazes catches fire, taking 2d8 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to douse itself.

unlocks.condition: Use this weapon to kill a surrendered or bound prisoner while witnesses watch (the DM judges that the surrender was genuine).
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, erupt in a 15-ft-radius burst of flame centered on you: 6d6 fire damage to creatures of your choice (DC 18 Dexterity save for half). The price: you are never quite cool again — you have vulnerability to cold damage.

name: Silorn Fenume, the Winter's Edge
flavorText: A trident salvaged from a shipwreck that froze mid-sinking. The cold it carries has never quite thawed.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Thrown (range 20/60), Versatile (1d8+4). On a hit, a wave of pressure adds an extra 2d8 cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be knocked Prone. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Knock 6 different creatures prone with this weapon within a single encounter.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, summon a 10-ft-radius surge of icy water on a point within 30 ft. For 1 minute the area is difficult terrain, creatures inside have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and cannot take reactions, and you and your allies inside have resistance to fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Grant a mercy killing with this weapon to a mortally wounded ally or creature who begged you for it.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, flood a 30-ft radius around you ankle-deep for 1 minute: enemies inside have disadvantage on attack rolls and their speed is halved. The price: the sea keeps its claim on you — you must fully immerse yourself in water for a minute each dawn or gain a level of exhaustion.

name: Nalorn, the Echo of War
flavorText: A greataxe that rang like a struck bell with every swing — until the ringing stopped being just sound.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Once per turn on a hit, a gust adds an extra 2d8 thunder damage and pushes the target 10 ft. directly away from you. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Carry the weapon to a mountain summit or tower top above the cloud line, and hold it aloft through one full storm there.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when a ranged attack targets you or an ally within 30 ft, the weapon howls and that attack is made with disadvantage. In addition, when you take the Dash action while holding it, every creature you move past must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be shoved 10 ft.

unlocks.condition: Use this weapon to sunder another magic weapon or magic item, destroying it completely.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, unleash a 30-ft cone of thunder: 6d6 thunder damage (DC 18 Constitution save for half), and each creature that fails is pushed 15 ft and deafened until the end of its next turn. The price: the wind never stops tugging at you — you automatically fail Stealth checks against anything within 60 ft, and torches and candles within 10 ft gutter out.

name: Grimorn Aethion, the Keeper
flavorText: A maul carried by a temple guard who, by every account, never once left his post before help arrived.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Once per turn when you hit with this weapon, your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Deliver a sealed message at least 50 miles overland in under 24 hours, on foot, carrying this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, take the Dash or Disengage action. While you hold the weapon, opportunity attacks made against you have disadvantage.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Wind at Your Back
unlocks.condition: Pay a sage, priest, or master smith at least 1000 gp to read this item's history, then travel to the place that reading names and spend a full night there with it.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, you and up to 4 willing allies within 30 ft each immediately move up to their full speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Goreth Koreth, the Hallowed Light
flavorText: A trident blessed at a shrine that no longer stands. Its prongs still catch light that isn't there.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Thrown (range 20/60), Versatile (1d8+4). On a hit, unravel the target with starlight for an extra 2d8 radiant damage, ignoring resistance to radiant damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Strike down 6 undead or fiends with this weapon's radiant damage.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, the weapon flares for 1 minute: invisible creatures and shapechangers in their true form within 30 ft are outlined in light, and attacks against them do not suffer disadvantage from being unseen.

unlocks.condition: Keep a seven-night vigil with the item at a shrine to a god of sun or light, or the ruins of one, never sleeping more than 4 hours a night and never leaving its side.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, name a creature you can see: it must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma save or be wreathed in light for 1 minute, unable to turn invisible or hide, and your attacks against it deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage.

name: Gloomforged War Pick
flavorText: A war pick forged in a mine shaft that was sealed off for a reason nobody wrote down. It works best where the light doesn't reach.
description: +4 to damage rolls. On a hit while you are in dim light or darkness, deal an extra 2d8 psychic damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Land the killing blow with this weapon's psychic damage on 6 different creatures while you stand in dim light or darkness.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action while you are in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

unlocks.condition: Seal a keepsake worth at least 1000 gp in a place that has never known light, and never return for it.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save or be frightened and unable to speak for 1 minute (it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns). The price: the weapon fills your sleep with whispers — you can no longer finish a long rest in dim light or darkness; resting anywhere but bright light grants you no benefit from it.

name: Nalara, the Stormcaller
flavorText: A warhammer struck by lightning on the forge, mid-quench, and never quite let go of it.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Versatile (1d10+4). On a hit, arcs of lightning add an extra 2d8 lightning damage and jump to one other creature within 10 ft. of the target (same damage, no save). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Chain the weapon's lightning to 3 or more creatures at once, on 3 separate occasions.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, charge the weapon for 1 minute: you gain resistance to lightning damage, and the first creature to hit you with a melee attack each turn takes 2d8 lightning damage.

unlocks.condition: Win a duel against the bearer of a similar relic (to the death or to a formal surrender), or defeat a storm giant, a roc, or another creature that commands lightning in single combat while holding it using no other magic item.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, raise a storm in a 60-ft radius for 1 minute; on each of your turns, as a bonus action, choose a creature in the area to take 2d8 lightning damage (no save, doubled against creatures wearing metal armor).

name: Adamantine Handaxe of the Whisper
flavorText: An adamantine handaxe that lands harder in the mind than the body. Thrown true, it leaves a target off-balance long after the wound stops hurting.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Thrown (range 20/60). On a hit, a lance of psychic feedback adds an extra 2d8 psychic damage, and the target has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a mind flayer, aboleth, or other mind-controlling creature without ever being charmed or dominated by it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action after you hit a creature, read its surface thoughts for 1 minute while it is within 60 ft: you learn what it intends to do on its next turn, and the first attack it makes against you before then has disadvantage.

unlocks.condition: Keep a seven-night vigil with the item at a place where minds have been broken: an asylum, a dream-shrine, or a mind flayer's lair, never sleeping more than 4 hours a night and never leaving its side.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, link minds: you and up to 4 willing creatures within 60 ft share thoughts telepathically for 8 hours and cannot be surprised.

name: Soundbound Maul
flavorText: A bronze maul that was never properly tempered — it rings on impact instead of thudding, loud enough to knock nearby ears flat on a solid hit.
description: +4 to damage rolls. On a critical hit, a thunderclap deals an extra 2d8 thunder damage to every creature within 10 ft. of the target (DC 18 Constitution save for half). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Hit with this weapon's thunderclap on a critical hit, catching 3 or more creatures, on 3 separate occasions.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, strike the ground or a wall to release a 15-ft cone of thunder: 2d8 thunder damage and deafened until your next turn (DC 18 Constitution save negates the deafness and halves the damage). The crack can be heard for 300 ft.

unlocks.condition: At an exposed summit or lightning-struck plain, destroy 1000 gp worth of treasure (melted down, burned, or sunk) as an offering to the weapon, during a single night-long ritual.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, shatter a nonmagical wall, door, or gate up to a 10-ft cube, and creatures within 10 ft of it take 6d6 thunder damage (DC 18 Constitution save for half). The price: the ringing never fades — you have disadvantage on hearing-based Perception checks and cannot hear whispers.

name: Warded Greataxe
flavorText: A greataxe etched with warding sigils from a battle-priest's personal ritual kit. Whatever the priest was protecting against, the axe still remembers how.
description: +4 to damage rolls. While holding this weapon, gain a +3 bonus to saving throws against spells. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a hostile spellcaster able to cast 5th-level spells in single combat while holding this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 60 ft casts a spell of 4th level or lower, counter it.

unlocks.condition: Betray a patron or employer who trusted you — deliver them to their enemies or take their treasure — while carrying this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a reaction when you succeed on a saving throw against a spell, absorb it: the spell has no effect on you and you regain 6d6 hit points. The price: magic recoils from you — beneficial spells cast on you by others (healing, buffs) fail.

name: Kelume Vexand, the Deathless
flavorText: A kukri that's outlasted three owners and, by most accounts, isn't finished yet. Wounds it opens are slow to close.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Finesse. On a hit, the wound withers for an extra 2d8 necrotic damage, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an equal amount until it finishes a long rest. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Lay the weapon on a grave or battlefield at least a century old for a full night, leaving a gift of at least 1000 gp worth of flowers, wine, or coin with it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action after you hit a creature, the wound festers: its speed is halved and it cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Gather three rare reagents (each from a different dangerous creature or location, with one taken from a wight, a wraith, or another creature that drains life) and use them to attune the item to you in a ritual at a graveyard, battlefield, or catacomb at least a century old.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a reaction when a creature hits you with an attack, age the blow: the attack deals half damage, and if the attacker's weapon is nonmagical it crumbles after its next hit.

name: Zareth Thalith, the Deafening
flavorText: A battle staff carved with a spiral said to trap sound. Landing a solid hit with it proves the story true.
description: +4 to damage rolls. On a critical hit, a thunderclap deals an extra 2d8 thunder damage to every creature within 10 ft. of the target (DC 18 Constitution save for half). Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the weapon to breach a locked gate, barricade, or fortress wall that blocks the party's way.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, strike the ground or a wall to release a 15-ft cone of thunder: 2d8 thunder damage and deafened until your next turn (DC 18 Constitution save negates the deafness and halves the damage). The crack can be heard for 300 ft.

unlocks.condition: At an exposed summit or lightning-struck plain, destroy 1000 gp worth of treasure (melted down, burned, or sunk) as an offering to the weapon, during a single night-long ritual.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, shatter a nonmagical wall, door, or gate up to a 10-ft cube, and creatures within 10 ft of it take 6d6 thunder damage (DC 18 Constitution save for half). The price: the ringing never fades — you have disadvantage on hearing-based Perception checks and cannot hear whispers.

name: Siland Thalael, the Burning Vow
flavorText: A morningstar whose spikes stay faintly warm to the touch — hot enough to matter the moment it lands a hit.
description: +4 to damage rolls. On a hit, the wound cauterizes into flame for an extra 2d8 fire damage. Sheds dim firelight 10 ft. while drawn. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Set 6 different creatures ablaze with this weapon's flame within a single encounter.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, the weapon blazes for 1 minute: bright light in a 30-ft radius, and each creature you hit while it blazes catches fire, taking 2d8 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to douse itself.

unlocks.condition: Win a duel against the bearer of a similar relic (to the death or to a formal surrender), or defeat a fire elemental, a hell hound, or another creature of living flame in single combat while holding it using no other magic item.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, plunge the weapon into fire to temper it: for 1 hour its fire damage ignores resistance and immunity to fire, and any structure it strikes catches alight.

name: Grimoth Vyrion, the Silent Scream
flavorText: A battleaxe that hums faintly in darkness, like it's listening for something only it can hear.
description: +4 to damage rolls. Versatile (1d10+4). On a hit while you are in dim light or darkness, deal an extra 2d8 psychic damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Spend three consecutive nights in a lightless place (a deep cave, crypt, or sealed cellar) without lighting any flame, with the weapon drawn across your lap.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action while you are in dim light or darkness, teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

unlocks.condition: Swear a binding oath before a priest or witnesses, then break it while wielding this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save or be frightened and unable to speak for 1 minute (it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns). The price: the weapon fills your sleep with whispers — you can no longer finish a long rest in dim light or darkness; resting anywhere but bright light grants you no benefit from it.

name: Grimand, the Frostbitten
flavorText: A longbow strung with something that was never quite rope. Arrows loosed from it arrive colder than they left.
description: +4 to damage rolls. On a hit, a wave of pressure adds an extra 2d8 cold damage and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be knocked Prone. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Knock 6 different creatures prone with this weapon within a single encounter.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, summon a 10-ft-radius surge of icy water on a point within 30 ft. For 1 minute the area is difficult terrain, creatures inside have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and cannot take reactions, and you and your allies inside have resistance to fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Pay a sage, priest, or master smith at least 1000 gp to read this item's history, then travel to the place that reading names and spend a full night there with it.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, you and up to 4 allies within 30 ft gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed and can breathe water for 8 hours.

name: Vexiel, the Silent Scream
flavorText: A set of half-plate etched with wide-open eyes across the chestplate — the kind that make you feel watched, and make anything sneaking up on you feel watched right back.
description: AC 7 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be reduced to 0 HP while wearing this armor and be back on your feet within the same encounter.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a charm or fear effect, you shout a warning: the ally has advantage on the save, and you can end the frightened condition on them.

unlocks.condition: Destroy a spellbook, scroll collection, or library worth at least 1000 gp that someone depends on.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, take the Dodge action and force each enemy within 10 ft to make a DC 18 Wisdom save or be compelled to attack only you until the end of your next turn. The price: you can no longer sleep soundly — you gain no benefit from a long rest unless you pass a DC 18 Wisdom save.

name: Vyrorn Aethash, the Gravebound
flavorText: Chain mail pulled from a mass grave that, according to the burial record, should still have had a body in it.
description: AC 8. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Once per long rest, when you take damage that would reduce you below half your hit point maximum, regain 2d8 hit points instead. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be the one to keep the party alive: stabilize or heal 6 different downed allies yourself while wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, spend a Hit Die: regain hit points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier, and gain advantage on death saving throws until the end of your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Wear this armor and abandon an ally or companion who is begging you not to leave them, and leave them to their fate.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, give an ally within 30 ft hit points equal to 3 times your level, taken from your own (you can drop to 1 hit point this way). The price: your hit point maximum is permanently reduced by 18.

name: Cognizant Ring Mail
flavorText: Ring mail that seems to flinch half a second before its wearer does. Whoever forged it clearly knew what was coming.
description: AC 7. Heavy armor. Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand a full night watch alone at a gate, bridge, or camp, and let no one pass unseen.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a charm or fear effect, you shout a warning: the ally has advantage on the save, and you can end the frightened condition on them.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a mage, a lich, or another master of spells of CR 11 or higher while wearing it, dealing the killing blow yourself.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, your allies within 30 ft are warded for 1 hour: they cannot be surprised, and they have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

name: Vyrith Solara, the Mindbreaker
flavorText: Studded leather worn by a bodyguard famous for reacting to danger before anyone else in the room had noticed it.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier. Light armor. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand a full night watch alone at a gate, bridge, or camp, and let no one pass unseen.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a charm or fear effect, you shout a warning: the ally has advantage on the save, and you can end the frightened condition on them.

unlocks.condition: Keep a seven-night vigil with the item at a mage's tower, a ward-circle, or a library vault, never sleeping more than 4 hours a night and never leaving its side.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, your allies within 30 ft are warded for 1 hour: they cannot be surprised, and they have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

name: Korara Vexael, the Wildfire
flavorText: A cape that never quite stops smoldering at the hem, no matter how many times it's been doused.
description: +2 AC. Resistance to fire damage. Once per short rest, when you take fire damage, flare back 2d8 fire damage at the attacker. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Take fire damage on 6 separate occasions while wearing it and keep fighting each time.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, ignite for 1 minute: you shed bright light in a 20-ft radius, you are immune to fire damage and the burning condition, and creatures that start their turn within 5 ft of you take 2d8 fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Return the item to where it was made (or the nearest place to it) and re-temper it: spend 24 hours and 1000 gp of materials at an active forge, volcano, or burnt-out ruin.
unlocks.reward: If you are killed while wearing it, your body bursts into flame, and at the next dawn you rise from the ashes with half your hit points. This can happen only once every 30 days.

name: Feniel Zariel, the Long Winter
flavorText: Hide armor scraped from something that lived comfortably at the top of a mountain most people don't survive visiting.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. Resistance to cold damage. You and your gear are unaffected by extreme cold and never need to check for frostbite. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Survive 3 separate encounters against creatures of CR 11 or higher while wearing this armor, with each of those creatures having hit you at least once.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you take damage, rime flashes over you: reduce the damage by 18, and the attacker's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

unlocks.condition: Wear this armor while taking a bribe to look the other way as harm is done to someone under your protection.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, a 20-ft aura of killing cold surrounds you for 1 minute: enemies that start their turn inside take 2d8 cold damage and have their speed halved. The price: warmth abandons you — you have vulnerability to fire damage.

name: Keland Silith, the Bellower
flavorText: A pair of gauntlets that clap like thunder on impact — loud enough that the wearer usually hears about it before feeling it.
description: +2 AC. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you take no falling damage from a fall of 30 feet or less. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Cross a rope bridge, narrow ledge, or high wire at least 100 ft above the ground in a storm, wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you fall or are knocked prone, catch the wind: you take no damage and land on your feet, and each creature within 5 ft is pushed back 5 ft.

unlocks.condition: Keep a seven-night vigil with the item at a mountain pass above the cloud line, never sleeping more than 4 hours a night and never leaving its side.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, you and up to 4 allies within 30 ft float on the wind: for 1 hour you ignore falling damage and difficult terrain and gain a +10 ft bonus to your jump distance.

name: Shield of the Voltaic
flavorText: A shield with a faint metallic tang in the air around it, like the moment right before a storm breaks.
description: +4 AC. Resistance to lightning damage. Once per long rest, when struck in melee, discharge 2d8 lightning damage to the attacker. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand on an exposed summit or open plain during a thunderstorm wearing it until lightning strikes you.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you are hit by a melee attack, discharge: the attacker takes 2d8 lightning damage and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

unlocks.condition: Pay a sage, priest, or master smith at least 1000 gp to read this item's history, then travel to the place that reading names and spend a full night there with it.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, link yourself to up to 4 allies within 30 ft for 1 minute: when any of you take lightning damage, all of you share it equally, and you can attack with lightning arcing between you.

name: Vorax, the Gravebound
flavorText: A shield recovered from a tomb raid that, by the raiders' own account, they didn't actually win.
description: +4 AC. Once per long rest, when you take damage that would reduce you below half your hit point maximum, regain 2d8 hit points instead. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Be reduced to 0 HP while wearing this armor and be back on your feet within the same encounter.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, spend a Hit Die: regain hit points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier, and gain advantage on death saving throws until the end of your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Swear a binding oath before a priest or witnesses, then break it while wearing this armor.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, give an ally within 30 ft hit points equal to 3 times your level, taken from your own (you can drop to 1 hit point this way). The price: your hit point maximum is permanently reduced by 18.

name: Circlet of the Blightvenom
flavorText: A circlet grown, not forged, from something that used to be a plant. It made its peace with poison a long time ago.
description: +1 AC. Resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Survive a bite or sting from a dangerous venomous creature (giant spider, wyvern, or similar) while wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when a creature within 5 ft of you is poisoned or takes poison damage, you siphon the toxin: the creature takes no damage from it and you gain 18 temporary hit points.

unlocks.condition: Wear this armor while taking a bribe to look the other way as harm is done to someone under your protection.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, exhale a 15-ft cone of venom: 6d6 poison damage (DC 18 Constitution save for half), and a creature that fails is poisoned for 1 minute. The price: you are always faintly poisoned — you have disadvantage on Charisma checks against creatures that can smell you.

name: Vexeth Vororn, the Long Winter
flavorText: A cape woven from something that was never quite wool, from somewhere the seasons don't change.
description: +2 AC. Resistance to cold damage. You and your gear are unaffected by extreme cold and never need to check for frostbite. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Cross a glacier, frozen sea, or snow-choked pass of at least 20 miles on foot wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you take damage, rime flashes over you: reduce the damage by 18, and the attacker's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

unlocks.condition: Win a duel against the bearer of a similar relic (to the death or to a formal surrender), or defeat a winter wolf, a frost giant, or another creature of ice in single combat while wearing it using no other magic item.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, raise a wall of ice up to 30 ft long and 10 ft high within 60 ft of you; it lasts 1 hour or until destroyed.

name: Vorith Kelwyn, the Dawnbringer
flavorText: A pair of gloves that stay warm to the touch no matter the hour, like they're still catching the first light of some other morning.
description: +2 AC. Resistance to radiant damage. Undead within 10 ft. of you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Survive 3 separate encounters against creatures of CR 11 or higher while wearing this armor, with each of those creatures having hit you at least once.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you glow with dawn light for 1 minute: shed bright light in a 20-ft radius, and undead and fiends that start their turn there take 2d8 radiant damage.

unlocks.condition: Win a duel against the bearer of a similar relic (to the death or to a formal surrender), or defeat a fiend, a revenant, or another creature that hates the light in single combat while wearing it using no other magic item.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, call a sunrise: a 30-ft radius around you becomes bright sunlight for 10 minutes, and you and your allies inside regain 18 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

name: Thalwyn Korwyn, the Hallowed Light
flavorText: Gauntlets blessed at a chapel that's since fallen — though the blessing apparently didn't hear about that.
description: +2 AC. Resistance to radiant damage. Undead within 10 ft. of you have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Defeat 6 undead or fiends while wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you glow with dawn light for 1 minute: shed bright light in a 20-ft radius, and undead and fiends that start their turn there take 2d8 radiant damage.

unlocks.condition: Return the item to where it was made (or the nearest place to it) and re-temper it: spend 24 hours and 1000 gp of materials at a shrine to a god of sun or light, or the ruins of one.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, call a sunrise: a 30-ft radius around you becomes bright sunlight for 10 minutes, and you and your allies inside regain 18 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

name: Vexiel Kelael, the Thunderstruck
flavorText: A pair of gloves that crackle faintly in a storm, like they're arguing with the weather.
description: +2 AC. Resistance to lightning damage. Once per long rest, when struck in melee, discharge 2d8 lightning damage to the attacker. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand on an exposed summit or open plain during a thunderstorm wearing it until lightning strikes you.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when you are hit by a melee attack, discharge: the attacker takes 2d8 lightning damage and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

unlocks.condition: Wear this armor through three consecutive days without removing it or sleeping anywhere but a place you have never slept before.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, become a lightning rod for 1 minute: lightning damage heals you instead of harming you, and every turn you can discharge 2d8 lightning damage at a creature you can see within 60 ft. The price: you take double damage from thunder.

name: Vexith Myroth, the Silent Scream
flavorText: Gauntlets that close into a fist a half-second before their wearer consciously decides to make one.
description: +2 AC. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Shake off 6 separate charm or fear effects while wearing it.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a charm or fear effect, you shout a warning: the ally has advantage on the save, and you can end the frightened condition on them.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a mage, a lich, or another master of spells of CR 11 or higher while wearing it, dealing the killing blow yourself.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as an action, your allies within 30 ft are warded for 1 hour: they cannot be surprised, and they have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

name: Silwyn Vorith, the Last Ember
flavorText: Hide armor tanned over a fire that, by the tanner's own insistence, never fully went out afterward.
description: AC 6 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Medium armor. Resistance to fire damage. Once per short rest, when you take fire damage, flare back 2d8 fire damage at the attacker. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Walk through a burning building, field, or smoldering ruin to rescue a person or object, wearing it the entire way.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, ignite for 1 minute: you shed bright light in a 20-ft radius, you are immune to fire damage and the burning condition, and creatures that start their turn within 5 ft of you take 2d8 fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Win a duel against the bearer of a similar relic (to the death or to a formal surrender), or defeat a fire elemental, a hell hound, or another creature of living flame in single combat while wearing it using no other magic item.
unlocks.reward: If you are killed while wearing it, your body bursts into flame, and at the next dawn you rise from the ashes with half your hit points. This can happen only once every 30 days.

name: Crown of the Whisperbound
flavorText: A crown that sits a little too comfortably, like it's used to being worn by someone paying close attention.
description: +1 AC. Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and you can't be surprised while wearing it. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Stand a full night watch alone at a gate, bridge, or camp, and let no one pass unseen.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, as a reaction when an ally within 30 ft is targeted by a charm or fear effect, you shout a warning: the ally has advantage on the save, and you can end the frightened condition on them.

unlocks.condition: At a mage's tower, a ward-circle, or a library vault, destroy 1000 gp worth of treasure (melted down, burned, or sunk) as an offering to the armor, during a single night-long ritual.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, take the Dodge action and force each enemy within 10 ft to make a DC 18 Wisdom save or be compelled to attack only you until the end of your next turn. The price: you can no longer sleep soundly — you gain no benefit from a long rest unless you pass a DC 18 Wisdom save.

name: A Chest That Shouldn't Exist
flavorText: An ordinary-looking chest that is, by every account anyone can find, not supposed to be here — no ledger lists it, no mason recalls sealing it into this wall, and the dust around it undisturbed for longer than the building has stood.
description: Open to find a haul of celestial-tier loot and coin.

name: Fragment of Grief
flavorText: A shard of grey-black glass, cold to the touch no matter the weather. Looking into it too long shows you a face you've lost. It was not made — it was left behind, the way a scar is left behind.
description: +3 Wisdom while attuned. Once per long rest, when you or a creature within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, you may cast True Resurrection on them with no material component and no cost. Curse: every time you use the shard, make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you will try to kill yourself, using any means available, until you are stopped or you drop to 0 HP. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the shard's True Resurrection to save a creature, then fail the curse's saving throw and continue carrying it anyway for 7 more days.
unlocks.reward: The curse's saving throw DC drops to 12.

name: Fragment of Rage
flavorText: A shard the deep red of an old bruise, warm even in winter. It thrums faintly, like a held breath about to break. Whoever carved it out of whatever it came from did not do so gently.
description: +5 Strength while attuned. Whenever you make an attack, you may choose to add extra damage equal to (1d2)^(1d20)^(1d20), worked left to right: roll a d2 and raise it to the power of a d20, then raise that result to the power of another d20. The extra damage only lands on a 50/50 chance (heads you add it, tails you don't). Curse: while below half your maximum HP, you cannot willingly end your turn without either attacking or moving toward the nearest hostile creature, and cannot choose to disengage or retreat. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: End a combat encounter below half HP without the curse causing you to attack an ally or take an action you tried to avoid.
unlocks.reward: The extra damage lands on a 2-in-3 chance instead of 1-in-2, and the curse's restriction no longer applies once you drop below one-quarter HP instead of one-half.

name: Fragment of Dread
flavorText: A shard so dark it seems to swallow candlelight near it. Holding it still, you can feel — faintly, at the edges — the specific fear of someone who is no longer around to be afraid.
description: +3 Charisma while attuned. Once per short rest, force every creature of your choice within 30 ft. that can see you to make a DC 20 Wisdom save or become Frightened of you for 1 minute; any creature that fails by 5 or more also drops whatever it's holding and uses all of its movement fleeing directly away from you on its next turn. Curse: once per day, the GM secretly calls for a DC 14 Wisdom save from you; on a failure, you must spend your next turn fleeing the nearest threat, whether or not it is actually dangerous. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Succeed on 5 of the curse's secret saving throws.
unlocks.reward: The Frighten ability's save DC increases to 22, and you gain advantage on the curse's own secret saving throw from then on.

name: Fragment of Envy
flavorText: A shard cut with too many facets, like it couldn't decide what it wanted to be. Every angle shows a different reflection — always slightly better looking, slightly more accomplished, than the one actually holding it.
description: +3 Dexterity while attuned. Three times per day, you may change any dice roll (an attack roll, ability check, saving throw, or damage roll made by you or a creature you can see) to any number you choose. Curse: the shard only works while you carry the most gold of anyone in your group on your person. If another party member carries more gp than you, its effect is switched off until you are the richest again. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the shard to hand a rival success instead of claiming it for yourself or an ally.
unlocks.reward: The ability can be used 4 times per day instead of 3.

name: Fragment of Despair
flavorText: A shard so heavy it seems to pull the hand that holds it downward. It doesn't glow, exactly — it dims everything around it a little, the way a bad memory dims a good day.
description: +5 Constitution while attuned. While below half your maximum HP, you have resistance to all damage. Curse: whenever an ally within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, you must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom save or become Poisoned until the end of your next turn, overwhelmed by the shard's grief. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Remain standing and fighting through 5 instances of the curse triggering.
unlocks.reward: The curse's save DC drops to 12, and the resistance granted below half HP becomes resistance to all damage regardless of your current HP.

name: Fragment of Ecstasy
flavorText: A shard the warm gold of late afternoon light, humming with something between a laugh and a held note. It is, unmistakably, the only fragment that seems happy to be held — which some who have carried it find more unsettling than any of the others.
description: +3 Charisma while attuned. Once per day each, cast Vision of Elapsing Eons and cast Weird, without expending a spell slot or material components. Curse: you cannot willingly harm a creature that is not currently attacking you or an ally — the shard floods you with an indiscriminate, overriding love for everything around you. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Use the shard to spare the life of a creature that was, at the time, hostile to you.
unlocks.reward: Both spells become available twice per day, and each can also remove one condition of your choice from you.

name: Fragment of Guilt
flavorText: A shard etched with fine lines that, from any distance, look like a face turned away. It is lighter than it looks, as though whatever weight it should have has been quietly passed along to whoever is holding it instead.
description: +3 Wisdom while attuned. Once per day, cast Dominate Monster at 9th level without expending a spell slot or material components; the saving throw DC is 20 (Wisdom). Curse: whenever you knowingly cause harm to an innocent creature, you gain one level of Exhaustion that cannot be removed by any rest, only by an atonement the GM designs. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Complete a GM-designed atonement to remove Exhaustion caused by the shard's curse.
unlocks.reward: Dominate Monster can be cast twice per day.

name: Fragment of Pride
flavorText: A shard of polished white-gold that shows every viewer a flattering reflection, a little taller and a little surer than they are. It is warm, and it hums when you stand up straighter.
description: Once per day, click the shard to reroll your ability scores: roll 1d10, 1d12, two d20s and two d100s (one d100 each), and each die is assigned to a random ability score. The new scores replace your own for 8 hours, or until you destroy the shard (discard it). Curse: the rapid change crushes your body. Each time you reroll, make a DC 10 Strength check or take 1d100 damage. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Let the reroll leave you with a lower total than your own scores, and keep the shard for 7 more days.
unlocks.reward: The curse's Strength check drops to DC 5.

name: Seraph's Wing Blade
flavorText: A greatsword of living silver that has never fully decided whether it is a blade or a feather. The metal shifts like mercury when the light moves and the edge is too fine to see directly. It belonged to a seraph who chose to die defending something mortal, and the god who reforged it into a weapon did so without fully understanding what they were working with.
description: +5 to damage rolls. Deals radiant damage. +2d8 radiant on every hit; +4d8 radiant against fiends and undead. Fiends and undead that attempt to wield it take 4d6 radiant damage per round. Holy Aura: while attuned, you emit a 10-ft aura of divine light — fiends and undead within the aura have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Once per day: cast Holy Aura (no spell slot, no components) centered on yourself for 1 minute. Requires attunement by a creature of good alignment.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 5 demon lords, archdevils, or CR 20+ fiends.
unlocks.reward: All celestials encountered are automatically friendly and will not attack unless attacked first. Holy Aura upgrade: allies within the 10-ft aura also gain +2 to attack and damage rolls.

unlocks.condition: Find and read the seraph's true name — requiring considerable research, divine favor, or a journey to the upper planes.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: summon the seraph's spirit for 1 hour (full Deva statistics, maximum HP). The +4d8 radiant vs. fiends/undead upgrades to +6d8. Immune to charm, fear, and possession by any means.

name: Aegis Eternal
flavorText: Full plate cut from the actual shield-skin of a titan who was slain by a god, then given by that god to the first mortal ever recorded showing a titan mercy. The armor is warm to the touch regardless of temperature and the engraving on the breastplate changes slowly over years to reflect whatever the wearer considers most worth protecting.
description: AC 15. Immune to critical hits. A faint golden halo hovers above the wearer's head at all times, visible even in absolute darkness (cannot be suppressed). Resistance to all non-magical damage. Once per day as a bonus action: activate Eternal Ward — for 1 minute, the wearer has resistance to all damage types (including magical), immunity to the Frightened and Charmed conditions, and any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 2d8 radiant damage. Requires attunement by a lawful creature.

unlocks.condition: Survive 3 encounters already below 50 HP when combat starts, without healing beforehand.
unlocks.reward: Eternal Ward duration increases to 10 minutes. The melee retaliation damage increases to 4d8 radiant and now applies to ranged attackers who can see you.

unlocks.condition: Find the site where the titan was slain — a specific location the GM establishes — and spend a long rest there wearing the armor.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest: become Huge for 1 minute (Strength 30, reach 15 ft., 4d10 bludgeoning unarmed). Creatures of Large size or smaller hit must make DC 20 Strength save or be knocked prone. The halo blinds (DC 18 Con) creatures within 10 ft.

name: The Last Star
flavorText: A longbow strung with a single strand of actual night sky, pulled free before the sky noticed it was missing. It has been faintly cold since the moment it was made and has never once been fully silent — a sound too low to be called music plays from it whenever it is drawn, and it whispers the name of a different star each time. Astronomers who have seen it refuse to discuss what they observed.
description: +5 to damage rolls. Arrows loosed leave a fading constellation trail in the air for 1 round. Attacks against flying creatures cannot miss (automatic hit, resolve damage normally). Once per day: Starfall Shot — loose an arrow that detonates overhead in a 30-ft radius burst of starlight. All creatures of your choice in the radius take 8d8 radiant damage (DC 18 Dex save for half) and are Blinded until the end of their next turn on a failed save. The sky directly above the impact point shows the named constellation regardless of weather or time of day for 1 minute afterward. Requires attunement.

unlocks.condition: Navigate by starlight alone (no map, compass, or landmarks) at least 10 miles through unmarked wilderness at night, and arrive within a quarter mile of the destination you declared.
unlocks.reward: Darkvision 120 ft. and see through magical darkness. Once per day: your star answers a yes/no question — the GM answers honestly.

unlocks.condition: Shoot an arrow into the actual night sky with sincere intent of claiming a second star — not a ceiling or illusion.
unlocks.reward: Second Starfall Shot per day. Once per week: fire into the sky to call a meteor — 30-ft radius impact up to 1 mile away deals 20d6 fire + 20d6 bludgeoning (DC 20 Dex for half). Permanent terrain change. Visible for 10 miles.

name: Robe of the Unwritten Fate
flavorText: A robe woven by the Fates from a single thread they refused, for reasons unrecorded, to cut. The woven pattern changes slowly — not in response to anything the wearer does, but in response to what they are about to do. Scholars who have studied it closely report that the pattern is always approximately three decisions ahead. This is considered either very reassuring or very disturbing depending on the scholar.
description: AC 16 + Dex modifier while not wearing armor. +3 to all saving throws. Concentration cannot be broken by taking damage while wearing this robe — you still make Constitution saves, but on a failure you simply choose to maintain concentration instead. Once per day: after seeing any die roll (yours or a creature's within 60 ft.), reroll it and choose which result stands. Once per long rest: impose a specific outcome on one die roll before it is made — the die shows whatever result you declare. Requires attunement by a spellcaster.

unlocks.condition: Use Predestined Outcome 5 times, each time turning a failed roll into a success that changes the outcome of the encounter (the DM confirms).
unlocks.reward: Predestined Outcome upgrades to twice per long rest. Once per day: a spell you cast deals maximum damage (all dice at highest value) — the Fates wrote it this way.

unlocks.condition: Find and speak with one of the Fates directly — a divine encounter requiring a planar journey — and ask them about the thread in this robe.
unlocks.reward: +5 to all saving throws (upgraded from +3). Reroll per day upgrades to twice per day. Once per month: cast Foresight (no concentration) on yourself lasting 24 hours instead of 8.

name: Chalice of Endless Grace
flavorText: A golden cup from a divine banquet where no guest ever left hungry.
description: Restores 20d4+40 HP, removes all conditions, and restores all expended spell slots and class features. Refills once per week with a drink that tastes like the drinker's favorite childhood meal.

unlocks.condition: Drink from the Chalice on 10 separate occasions.
unlocks.reward: Each drink also removes up to 2 levels of exhaustion, and the Chalice refills twice per week instead of once.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Guest Who Never Leaves
unlocks.condition: Share a drink from the Chalice with 5 different allies over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: Once per month, the Chalice can be shared: all creatures within 30 ft. when it is drunk receive the same restoration (HP, conditions removed, spell slots restored) simultaneously, without using an extra weekly refill.

name: Crown of the First Dawn
flavorText: Worn by the first mortal ruler ever crowned directly by the gods, at a ceremony that made several of the attending gods uncomfortable for reasons they declined to explain publicly. The crown is plain enough that people are surprised, on seeing it, that it is the thing in question. It gets warmer as morning approaches and cooler after noon, regardless of weather or what room you are in.
description: +2 AC. Immunity to the Blinded condition and to magical darkness. Creatures of the Undead type within 30 ft. that start their turn in your presence must make DC 18 Constitution save or take 4d6 radiant damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn. Once per day: cast Sunbeam (8d8 radiant per ray, DC 18 Con save, blinds on failed save) as an action.
